title: Outdoor living and construction design, rendering and admin
description:
Looking Construction Administrative & Design Virtual Assistant



We are a growing U.S.-based construction and outdoor living company looking for a highly organized, dependable, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help manage the day-to-day administrative and project support side of our business.



This is not just a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can help keep projects organized, assist with estimates and scheduling, manage project information and photos, and also help with design/rendering work.



The right person will be comfortable learning our existing systems, working independently, following up on tasks, and helping improve the organization of our company.



Main Responsibilities

Administrative & Project Organization

Organize project files, folders, documents, photos, and customer information

Organize and maintain jobsite photos

Upload, sort, label, and manage project photos in our current software

Keep customer and project information current

Track projects from lead through estimate, contract, construction, and completion

Maintain project notes, to-do lists, and follow-up items

Help keep management informed of upcoming deadlines and unfinished tasks

Assist with customer communication and internal project communication when needed

Estimating & Proposals

Create and begin construction estimates from project information provided by our team

Enter labor, material, subcontractor, allowance, and other project costs

Help build professional customer proposals

Update existing estimates when project scope changes

Keep estimate templates organized and consistent

Track estimates that have been sent and identify which customers need follow-up

Help create change orders and project cost updates



Construction estimating experience is strongly preferred.



Job Tracking & Scheduling

Maintain an organized schedule of current and upcoming projects

Track project start dates, projected completion dates, inspections, deliveries, subcontractors, and customer appointments

Help coordinate crews and subcontractors

Keep a running list of materials, selections, and outstanding project items

Help identify scheduling conflicts before they become problems

Maintain project status reports for management

Track jobs through each stage of construction

Design & Renderings



We would like this person to also assist with creating professional designs and renderings for customer projects.



Experience with one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



SketchUp

Planner 5D or similar 3D design software

Structure Studios VIP3D

Pool Studio

VizTerra

Outdoor living design software

Architectural or landscape rendering software



Projects may include:



Swimming pools

Outdoor living spaces

Decks

Covered patios

Pavilions

Outdoor kitchens

Fireplaces

Retaining walls

Landscaping

Home additions

Interior remodeling projects



The ability to take rough measurements, sketches, photos, plans, or verbal direction and turn them into a professional 2D or 3D presentation is a major advantage.



Software & Technology



You should be comfortable learning and working with different software programs.



Experience with construction management or project management software is preferred.



You should also be comfortable with:



Google Drive

Google Docs

Google Sheets

Microsoft Excel


Calendar management

PDF documents

Cloud-based file organization

Photo organization

Construction/project management software

Estimating software

Design/rendering software



Experience with CompanyCam is a plus.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Reliable

Honest

Consistent

Able to work independently

Comfortable asking questions when information is missing

Good at following written and verbal instructions

Able to manage multiple projects at the same time

Able to recognize when something has been forgotten or needs follow-up

Willing to learn new construction processes and software

Comfortable working in a fast-moving construction environment



We do not want someone who only waits for instructions.



We want someone who can eventually understand our system well enough to say:



"This estimate still needs to be completed."



"This customer needs a follow-up."



"This project is missing selections."



"This subcontractor needs to be scheduled."



"These jobsite photos have not been organized."



"This project is approaching its scheduled start date."



Construction Experience



Previous experience working with a:



General contractor

Remodeling company

Pool company

Deck company

Outdoor living company

Landscaping company

Architecture/design company



is strongly preferred.



Candidates with construction estimating, project coordination, or design experience will receive priority consideration.



English & Communication



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You will communicate directly with company management and may eventually assist with customer, vendor, and subcontractor communication.



You must be able to clearly understand construction instructions and communicate when information is missing or unclear.



Work Schedule



This is intended to become a long-term position.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and take on more responsibility over time.



Some working hours must overlap with U.S. Central Time so that we can communicate during the workday.



Specific working hours can be discussed based on experience and qualifications.



Growth Opportunity



For the right person, this position can grow into a major role within our company.



As trust and experience develop, responsibilities may expand into:



Project coordination

Estimating

Scheduling

Customer communication

Design

Purchasing

Subcontractor coordination

Sales support

Production management

Operations support



We are interested in finding someone for the long term, not just completing short-term tasks.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Tell us about your previous construction, estimating, project management, or design experience.

List the construction or project-management software you have used.

List the design/rendering software you have experience with.

Tell us your experience with SketchUp, Planner 5D, Structure Studios VIP3D, Pool Studio, VizTerra, or similar programs.

Send examples or a portfolio of any 3D renderings, construction drawings, estimates, proposals, schedules, or project-management work you have completed.

Tell us how you would organize 10 active construction projects with hundreds of jobsite photos, estimates, schedules, selections, subcontractors, and outstanding tasks.

Tell us your current availability and preferred working hours.

Tell us your desired hourly or monthly salary.

At the top of your application, write the words:



BUILD • ORGANIZE • DESIGN



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone who can help bring organization, consistency, and professionalism to a growing construction company while also helping us produce estimates, designs, and professional customer presentations.

title: Senior Construction Accountant / Bookkeeper (Remote)
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing fractional CFO and financial advisory firm that provides high-level financial strategy and controller services to sizable businesses. We are currently expanding our team and looking for a highly skilled Construction Accountant to take the lead on a large, Texas-based construction client, while also managing construction files for our broader client base.



The Role

We are looking for a specialist who deeply understands the complexities of construction accounting and is highly adaptable when it comes to technology. Our newest construction client is currently working in Sage and transitioning to Viewpoint Spectrum. However, several of our other construction clients operate entirely within QuickBooks Online (QBO). You will be responsible for cleaning up historical books, establishing solid job-costing workflows, managing WIP schedules, and navigating these multiple accounting platforms fluidly.



Working Hours & Availability (Strict Requirement)



You must be available to work during standard US business hours (Eastern or Pacific Time) every day, Monday through Friday.



Once you are fully trained and integrated into our workflows, we can offer some schedule flexibility, but your core working hours must always maintain a significant overlap with US business hours to ensure smooth communication with our team and clients.



Key Responsibilities



System Agility & Cleanup: Untangle messy books and manage construction files seamlessly across QBO, Sage, and Spectrum.



Job Costing: Accurately track and allocate direct and indirect costs to specific jobs and projects across all platforms.



WIP Management: Prepare, manage, and reconcile monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedules and over/under billing calculations.



AIA Billing & Retainage: Process complex progress billings (AIA formats) and accurately track Accounts Receivable retainage.



Month-End Close: Execute a rigorous month-end close process, preparing the balance sheet and profit & loss statements for CFO review.



General Ledger: Manage full-cycle accounting, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and payroll journal entries.



Requirements



Construction Expertise: 3+ years of dedicated experience in construction accounting (this is non-negotiable).



Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of percentage-of-completion accounting, WIP schedules, and retainage.



Software: You must be highly comfortable working in QuickBooks Online (QBO) specifically for construction clients. Experience with Sage (100 Contractor / 300 CRE) and Viewpoint Spectrum is highly preferred.



Problem Solver: Proven ability to step into a messy file, identify discrepancies, and systematically clean them up without needing to be micromanaged.



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter. 



Your subject line must include "Construction Bookkeeping Pro" or it will be automatically deleted. 



In your cover letter, please briefly explain your experience managing WIP schedules, confirm your availability to work US hours, and mention which construction accounting software platforms you are most comfortable using. (Applications without this will not be considered).

title: Shopify Expert
description:
Shopify Developer / Technical Specialist



We are looking for an experienced Shopify developer to help maintain, troubleshoot, and improve an established eCommerce website.



This is not primarily a product-entry, merchandising, or general Shopify administration role. We need someone who is comfortable working at the technical level of Shopify: themes, Liquid, JavaScript, third-party applications, collection and filtering logic, performance, and technical SEO.



What You’ll Be Working On



The immediate project involves troubleshooting several issues on an existing Shopify store, but we’re looking for someone with the broader technical expertise to identify the underlying causes and implement solutions safely.



Responsibilities may include:



* Troubleshooting and configuring third-party Shopify apps and integrations, including search, autocomplete, filtering, and merchandising applications

* Working with Shopify themes, Liquid, JavaScript, CSS, templates, sections, and related theme code

* Diagnosing conflicts between apps, theme customizations, and Shopify’s native functionality

* Configuring and troubleshooting Shopify Search & Discovery functionality and third-party search platforms such as Searchanise

* Troubleshooting collection pages, including incorrect products appearing in collections, collection rules, tags, metafields, filtering, and product sorting

* Understanding and correcting automated and manual collection logic

* Investigating problems where theme or application changes unexpectedly affect templates, collection content, navigation, or other areas of the site

* Reviewing and addressing technical issues identified through SEO/site audits

* Identifying urgent technical SEO problems versus issues that can reasonably be addressed during a future site redesign

* Improving site performance, crawlability, structured data, redirects, indexing behavior, and other technical Shopify/SEO issues where appropriate

* Maintaining existing functionality while making changes rather than solving one problem at the expense of another



Safe Development & Testing Is Important



We need someone who follows a proper Shopify development workflow.



Changes should generally be made to a duplicate/unpublished theme first, thoroughly tested, and presented for review before anything is deployed to the live site.



You should be comfortable:



* Duplicating, managing, and cleaning up Shopify themes

* Developing and testing against unpublished themes

* Previewing changes without affecting the production storefront

* Testing changes across product, collection, search, navigation, and other relevant templates

* Identifying potential dependencies before modifying theme code

* Deploying approved changes to production safely

* Rolling back changes when necessary



We specifically want to avoid making experimental changes directly to the live theme.



Current Priorities



Our first priority is an existing Searchanise implementation. Searchanise has updated its integration for Shopify, and the store needs to be configured so features such as search autocomplete, SKU/product matching, search suggestions, menus, and filtering operate correctly.



A previous attempt to implement the recommended changes caused unintended problems elsewhere on the site, including collection pages and collection-page content. We need someone capable of understanding the integration rather than simply following installation instructions and hoping it works.



Our second priority is diagnosing problems with Shopify collections and product sorting. Some collection pages currently display products that clearly do not belong in those collections. We need the collection rules, product data, filtering, sorting, theme logic, and any app involvement investigated and corrected.



We also have a technical site audit identifying additional issues. We’d like the developer to review these findings, determine which require immediate attention, and fix urgent problems. Less critical items may be incorporated into a larger upcoming site redesign.



Skills We’re Looking For



Strong experience with:



* Shopify theme development

* Shopify Liquid

* HTML/CSS

* JavaScript

* Shopify’s collection and product architecture

* Automated and manual collections

* Metafields and product data

* Search and filtering systems

* Third-party Shopify app integrations

* Debugging theme/app conflicts

* Shopify Search & Discovery

* Technical SEO for Shopify

* Performance troubleshooting

* Safe staging, testing, and deployment practices



Experience with Searchanise specifically would be a strong plus, but we’re more interested in finding someone who understands Shopify well enough to diagnose integration problems properly.



What We’re Looking For in a Developer



We’re looking for someone who can investigate a problem, determine why it is happening, and recommend the correct solution—not someone who needs every change specified line by line.



You should be comfortable inheriting an existing Shopify site, reading and understanding work done by previous developers, and distinguishing between theme problems, Shopify configuration problems, product-data problems, and third-party app problems.



Good communication is also important. Before making significant changes, we’d like a concise explanation of what you found, what you recommend changing, and whether there are any risks or dependencies.



When Applying



Please briefly describe:



* Your experience developing and troubleshooting Shopify stores

* Your experience with Liquid and custom Shopify themes

* Your experience troubleshooting third-party Shopify apps

* Any experience with Searchanise or similar search/filtering applications

* Your experience diagnosing collection/filtering issues

* Your familiarity with technical SEO on Shopify

* How you normally develop and test changes before deploying them to a live Shopify store



Please include examples of Shopify sites you’ve worked on and, if possible, examples of troubleshooting or repair work rather than only new site builds.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.



Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)







Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.







Lead the Marketing Growth of an Established Service Business

Cooper Roofing is an award-winning roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We are bringing our marketing operations in-house and looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead measurable growth through Google Ads, SEO, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics.



This is not a Social Media Manager position. We already have one in place.



We need someone who can take ownership of our paid and organic search strategy, improve lead generation, strengthen attribution, and help build a scalable customer-acquisition system.



You will report directly to the Founder and CEO.



Key Responsibilities

Reactivate, manage, and optimize Google Ads using six years of historical campaign data.

Develop and lead technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO strategies.

Manage Google Local Services Ads and Meta Ads where appropriate.

Improve landing-page conversion rates through testing and optimization.

Manage GoHighLevel tracking, dynamic number insertion, number pools, UTMs, and nurture sequences.

Maintain accurate attribution between marketing spend, leads, sales, and closed revenue.

Own Google Business Profile optimization, review generation, and local reputation strategy.

Conduct competitor analysis across advertising, SEO, offers, and positioning.

Develop seasonal lead-generation campaigns for roofing demand cycles.

Provide clear SEO and development direction to our web developer.

Direct the Social Media Manager's output where it supports the wider marketing strategy.

Produce weekly reports connecting marketing performance to actual business results.

Present results, explain performance, and recommend next steps directly to the CEO.

What We're Looking For

Strong Google Ads and SEO experience is essential.



We are specifically looking for someone with:



Demonstrated experience independently managing and optimizing Google Ads.

Strong technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO knowledge.

A proven track record of generating qualified leads and revenue for a service-based business.

Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROI, ROAS, and revenue attribution.

Experience with conversion tracking, call tracking, Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google Business Profile.

Experience developing SEO strategies and directing web developers.

Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear decisions.

Excellent written English and strong organizational skills.

Experience managing contractors, content creators, or other marketing team members.

Experience in roofing, construction, home services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, landscaping, or another local B2C service industry is highly valued.



Familiarity with JobNimbus, JustCall, Local Services Ads, structured data, AI-search optimization, or conversion-rate optimization is also an asset.



Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not primarily focused on:



Social media posting

Content scheduling

Graphic design

Influencer marketing

Community management

Brand-awareness campaigns without measurable lead-generation responsibility

We already have social media support.



We need someone whose strongest skills are Google Ads, SEO, analytics, attribution, and growing a service business through measurable digital marketing.



Pay and Benefits

Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: $1,000-$1,500 USD per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

Salary paid bi-weekly.

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct access to the Founder and CEO.

Access to six years of historical campaign data, an existing Social Media Manager, and a web developer.

Ongoing professional development and meaningful ownership of a major business function.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid skills assessment.

Applicants must consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours.

Candidates working from the Philippines should be comfortable maintaining the required evening or overnight schedule long term.

Why Cooper Roofing?

We are looking for someone who wants genuine responsibility for business growth.



Success in this role will be measured by qualified leads, customer acquisition cost, revenue, and growth, not social engagement metrics.



If you have strong Google Ads and SEO experience and can demonstrate how your marketing work has helped a service business generate leads and revenue, we want to hear from you.

title: Meta Ads Designer
description:
READ THIS FIRST!!

We are looking for a part-time Meta Ads Designer for approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to grow into a full-time position.

We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved in the brand — not someone who simply waits for a design brief, creates exactly what they're told, and moves on.

Creative initiative is extremely important to us.

We want a designer who looks at an idea and thinks:

“I know how I can make this stronger — and I already have three other versions we should test.”

You should be able to execute creative direction AND bring your own ideas to the table.

If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, develop your creative skills, learn what actually makes advertising perform, and potentially grow into a full-time position with a fast-growing brand, keep reading.



How to Apply

Please send us:

Show us your strongest work. We are especially interested in Meta ads, ecommerce advertising, direct-response creative, DTC, beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer brands.

Whether you have strong, reliable internet

Confirm your availability and hours

Confirm your skills to use Figma

Confirm you are interested in doing the test project 

If your portfolio looks like a fit, we'll send you a test project right away

With design, we believe the fastest way to identify great talent is to see the actual work. We're not interested in multiple interviews or hypothetical questions.

Resume + Portfolio → Test Project → Offer

If your test project is great, we'll move quickly toward an offer.



About MyMagicHealer

MyMagicHealer is a fast-growing consumer skincare company with a mission to help people stress less over their skin.

We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop and have served hundreds of thousands of customers.

Meta advertising is an important part of our growth, and we're looking for a talented designer to help us consistently produce exceptional advertising creative.



What You'll Own

Your primary responsibility will be designing high-performing Meta ad creatives.

You will work closely with our creative and growth team to turn customer research, hooks, offers, creative concepts, winning ads, and performance insights into new advertising creative.

You will:

Design static ads for Meta

Turn creative briefs and rough ideas into polished ads

Create multiple variations of winning creatives

Come up with your own visual concepts and advertising ideas

Research competitor ads and successful DTC brands

Study our winning and losing creatives

Use performance learnings to improve future designs

Test different layouts, headlines, product presentations, testimonials, benefits, offers, and visual approaches

Iterate quickly based on feedback

Keep creative files organized

Consistently deliver work on time



We Don't Just Want Someone Who Makes Things Pretty

A beautiful ad that doesn't communicate anything isn't a successful ad.

We are looking for someone who understands that Meta ads need to get attention, communicate quickly, and ultimately drive action.

You should naturally think:

Why would someone stop scrolling?

What's the first thing their eye sees?

Is the message immediately clear?

How could I make this concept stronger?

What else could we test?

You don't need to be a media buyer.

But you should be genuinely curious about what happens after your ad launches.

Did it perform?

Why?

What can we learn?

What should we create next?



What We're Looking For

You should have:

Strong graphic design skills

Excellent visual taste

Experience designing digital or social advertising

A strong understanding of typography, hierarchy, composition, contrast, and layout

Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar tools

Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow brand guidelines while still thinking creatively

Strong organization and time management

Ability to receive feedback and iterate quickly

Curiosity about advertising, consumer psychology, and creative performance

Experience with Meta Ads, ecommerce, DTC, skincare, beauty, wellness, supplements, or consumer brands is highly preferred.



Creative Initiative Is Extremely Important

We will give you:

Creative strategy

Customer research

Hooks

Messaging

Winning ads

Performance insights

References

Product information

But we do not want someone who needs every design decision explained to them.

We want you to bring ideas too.

You should regularly be looking at:

Meta Ad Library

Competitors

DTC brands

Creative trends

Winning ads

Customer reviews

Our own creative performance

…and thinking:

“What should we test next?”



What Success Looks Like

An exceptional person in this role will:

Consistently produce strong new Meta creatives

Deliver work on schedule

Quickly turn winning concepts into new iterations

Proactively bring new visual ideas to the team

Improve their creative based on performance data

Become increasingly independent

Understand our brand and customer deeply

Become someone the team can trust to take an idea and run with it

For the right person, there is an opportunity for this position to grow from approximately 20 hours/week into a full-time role as the company and creative needs continue to grow.



NON-NEGOTIABLE: Strong & Reliable Internet

This is extremely important.

Because this is a remote position, you MUST have strong and reliable internet.

You will regularly need to:

Download and upload large creative files

Work in cloud-based tools

Attend team calls

Communicate with the team

Access shared drives and project management systems

Repeated internet issues that prevent you from attending calls, uploading files, or completing work efficiently will not work for this role.

Please make sure you have a reliable internet connection and working setup before applying.



You Will Probably Love This Role If...

You constantly notice ads while scrolling.

You save interesting creatives because something about them catches your attention.

You enjoy figuring out why an ad works.

You get excited when something you designed performs well.

You don't need someone else to come up with every idea.

You're fast.

You're curious.

You're reliable.

You like feedback.

And when someone gives you one concept, your brain immediately starts thinking about five other ways to execute it.



You Should NOT Apply If...

You only want to execute exactly what is written in a brief

You need extremely detailed instructions before starting

You don't proactively bring creative ideas

You dislike receiving feedback or making iterations

You regularly miss deadlines

You aren't interested in understanding how your creative performs

You have unreliable internet

You struggle to communicate consistently while working remotely

You cannot reliably commit approximately 20 hours per week



One Last Thing

We're not hiring someone simply because they know how to use Photoshop, Canva, or Figma.

We're looking for a creative thinker who happens to be an excellent designer.

Someone who can execute.

Someone who brings ideas.

Someone who wants to know whether their work actually performed.

And someone who has the potential to grow with us from this part-time role into an important full-time member of our creative team.

title: Digital Marketer & Content Project Manager with AI Skills
description:
Digital Marketing, Content & AI Automation Manager



About the role

We are an international digital marketing and technology agency working with clients across different countries and industries.

We are looking for a proactive Digital Marketing, Content & AI Automation Manager to join our team on a long-term, part-time basis.



This is a broad, hands-on role combining digital marketing, content, SEO, project management and practical AI automation.

You will help turn client objectives into clear marketing actions, coordinate execution, create and improve content, analyse performance and identify opportunities where AI and automation can make our work smarter and more scalable.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows a content calendar or uses ChatGPT as a writing tool. We are looking for someone who understands the wider objective, takes ownership and actively looks for better ways to achieve results.



Responsibilities

• Manage marketing projects, priorities, deadlines and deliverables.

• Help develop marketing and content strategies for different clients.

• Plan and manage content across Instagram, LinkedIn,
, TikTok and YouTube.

• Research competitors, trends, keywords and content opportunities.

• Create and improve captions, hooks, headlines and marketing copy.

• Create or coordinate videos, carousels, graphics and other creative content.

• Edit short-form and longer-form video where required.

• Support SEO, Local SEO, AEO/GEO and on-page optimisation.

• Monitor performance using GA4, Search Console and platform analytics.

• Turn performance data into practical recommendations.

• Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools for research, content, analysis and productivity.

• Build practical automations

• Connect AI models and marketing tools using APIs, webhooks and structured data where required.

• Automate areas such as content research, repurposing, reporting, data collection and repetitive marketing tasks.

• Research and test new AI and marketing tools and recommend useful applications.

• Coordinate with developers, automation specialists and other team members.

• Communicate clearly with clients and the internal team.



Essential

• 2+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, content, social media or marketing project management.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing and content strategy.

• Good knowledge of SEO fundamentals.

• Strong written English.

• Experience with Canva or similar creative tools.

• Video editing experience using CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or similar.

• Strong practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

• Some hands-on experience creating automations with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar.

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON and how digital tools connect.

• Strong organisation and project management skills.

• Ability to manage several projects and priorities.

• Proactive, reliable and comfortable working independently.



Desirable

Experience in some of the following would be an advantage:

Local SEO and AEO/GEO, GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, Shopify, Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube optimisation, AI agents, MCP, AI image/video workflows, Python or JavaScript, web scraping, Airtable, Supabase or CRM integrations.

You do not need to be an expert in every one of these areas.

How we like to work



We are looking for someone who:

• understands the business objective before starting the task;

• takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions;

• combines creative judgement with analytical thinking;

• communicates problems and blockers early;

• can turn strategy into clear actions;

• experiments with new AI and marketing tools;

• looks for processes that can be improved or automated;

• builds useful solutions rather than impressive demos;

• is comfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment.

A question we want you to ask regularly is:

“Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?”

Commitment

This is a part-time, or long-term role. You do not need to be an expert in every one of these areas.



Our team operates primarily during European working hours, so reliable overlap with CET/CEST is required.

Starting compensation is approximately USD 500/month, depending on experience, availability and overall fit, with room to grow over time.



Start the first sentence of your application with the word “MARKETING” so we know you have read the full job description.



How to Apply



Please include:

• A short introduction and your relevant experience.

• Your location, time zone and weekly availability.

• Your expected monthly compensation.

• Your portfolio or examples of previous work.

• Examples of social media content, campaigns or accounts you have worked on.

• Examples of videos, graphics, carousels, thumbnails or other assets you personally created or helped produce.

• A brief example of a marketing or content strategy you worked on.

• A short explanation of your SEO experience.

• An example of an automation, AI workflow or integration you have built.

• The marketing, analytics, automation and AI tools you use regularly.

• A brief explanation of your personal contribution to each example you share.



We are particularly interested in understanding how you think, organise projects, create strong content, use AI intelligently, analyse performance and take ownership. Not simply which tools you have used.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
Job Title: Logistics Specialist



Company: Picnic Time Family of Brands



Picnic Time is a successful & sunny SoCal-based wholesale supplier of premium outdoor leisure, gift, and promotional products established in a garage in 1982. (Don’t worry, we have a real office now.) We know picnic, we love picnic, and we live picnic – it’s literally in our name.





Who we are: The Picnic Time Family is all about the people. We're a diverse team of hard-working yet easy-going people that care about what we're doing. If it weren't for the amazing group of people at Picnic Time, we wouldn't be where we are today.

What we do: We create quality products that are thoughtful, sustainable, and fun.  

When we do it:  We've been innovating since 1982 and we don't have any intention of slowing down.  The hope is that we'll be here creating great stuff for your kids' kids' kids!

Where the magic happens:  We were born in a small garage in West Hills, CA and moved to a bigger (ware)house in a small town, Moorpark, CA, in 1990.  We've been rockin’ the suburbs ever since!

Why we do what we do (this is the big one):  Our purpose for existing is to bring family and friends together so that they can make lasting memories...because that's what happiness is all about.  Each and every decision we make is ultimately geared toward that goal.

How we do it:  We're constantly driving towards our purpose via our 8 core values of Fun, Growth, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, Service, Productivity, and Passion.



Mission Statement: To create products that inspire friends and family to come together and make lasting memories – and have a great time doing it.



Job Description:



Under the supervision of the Logistics Solutions Manager, you will communicate staging instructions to our warehouse team to ship orders accurately, on time, and in compliance with our customers’ requirements.



 Duties will include:

• Reviewing and summarizing Routing/Vendor Guides to ensure compliance 

• Navigating various retailer vendor portals

• Creating pallet sheets, bills of lading, and instructions for the warehouse 

• Creating/ordering carton labels and price tickets

• Communicating shipment status with customers, carriers, and sales team

• Research and resolve chargebacks and fees from customers related to logistics

• Providing freight quotes to the sales team

• Scheduling pickups with carriers and tracking deliveries

• Creating and maintaining documentation for processes related to logistics for each assigned account

• Other duties as assigned







Specific Skills Required:



• Minimum 2 years’ experience working in logistics.

• Bachelor's Degree in a related field (Systems Operations Management or Supply Chain Management preferred)

• MS Office: Ability to collate/sort/organize data for presentation to multiple other teams depending on data needs

• MS Excel: Proficiency in functions such as VLOOKUP, data table formatting, and running macros

• MS Word: Proficiency in mail merge, label creation, and generating shipping documents such as pallet sheets/labels, BOLs, etc...

• Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive, etc...

• AI Tools: Experience in utilizing general or tailored AI tools such as Gemini or ChatGPT

• Experience with large retailers such as Amazon, TJ Maxx, Ross, Dicks Sporting Goods, Williams Sonoma, etc...

• Working directly with logistics broker companies and shipping carriers to quote, plan, and execute small-to-large volume shipments

• Experience with shipping direct import, POE (Point of Entry), or X-Works from overseas to cross-border (Mexico/Canada), including documents such as Customs Packing Lists, Commercial Invoices, Ocean BOLs, and FCR (Forwarder's Cargo Receipt), etc...



The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, highly organized, and accountable with careful attention to detail.



Must work collaboratively with the Logistics Solutions Team.



Must be able to communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.



Location: Remote (HQ is in Moorpark, CA)

Hours: West Coast US hours 7:30 AM – 4 PM Monday - Friday 

Salary: US$800 to $960/month depending on experience.

Employment Type: This is a full-time contract position requiring 40 hours per week. You will invoice us every two weeks with the actual hours worked. The company will pay a prorated 13th month of pay. There are no benefits for this position. The candidate will use their own PC, headset, and video cam and connect to a virtual workstation through a VPN. The company will provide all the software necessary.

About The VA Effect



The VA Effect helps U.S.-based business owners get more done by connecting them with dedicated virtual assistants who can support their businesses with administrative work, operations, customer service, marketing, lead generation, executive assistance, and more.



We are growing and looking for motivated people who can help us connect with more U.S. business owners.

Your Job



Your goal is NOT to close the sale.



We handle the sales calls and closing.



Your job is to identify U.S. business owners who could benefit from a virtual assistant, generate their interest, and get qualified prospects to schedule a meeting with us.

Creative lead-generation strategies

Any other ethical and legal method that produces results

We care much more about results than how many hours you work.

You will not be completely on your own.

Almost any legitimate U.S.-based business that could benefit from a virtual assistant.

There is no base salary or hourly pay.

Recurring commissions



We are flexible and willing to discuss a structure that makes sense for both sides.



You earn when we earn.



Commission is earned when a referred prospect becomes a paying client of The VA Effect. Payment will generally be made within 5 business days after the client's payment is received and the referral is verified.



There is no commission cap.



Bring one successful client, get paid for one.



Bring five, get paid for five.



Bring twenty, get paid for twenty.



We are looking for people who see the potential of building a serious income stream by consistently bringing qualified U.S. business owners to us.



Schedule

You can do this:



Full-time

Part-time

On evenings/weekends

Alongside another job

As an affiliate/referral business

Using your existing network or audience



We care about qualified opportunities and results.



Experience



No experience is required.



We are open to beginners as well as experienced:



Appointment setters

Lead generators

Cold callers

Cold
ers

Affiliate marketers

Social media marketers

Business development representatives

Sales professionals

Freelancers



If you're new but resourceful, motivated, comfortable communicating with business owners, and willing to figure out how to generate opportunities, we are interested.



Multiple Openings Available



We are not looking for only one person.



We are building a network of independent lead-generation and business-development partners.



If you have a good strategy and can bring qualified U.S. business owners to The VA Effect, there may be an opportunity for you.



How to Apply

Who We Are

title: Looking for AI-Assisted YouTube Thumbnail Designer
description:
Job Overview:



We’re looking for a talented Thumbnail Maker to join our team and create high-quality visual content for our YouTube channels, both focused on movie and entertainment content.



You’ll be responsible for creating eye-catching, high-converting YouTube thumbnails, while also helping with other visual content such as LinkedIn posts and carousel images.



We have AI tools available that you can use to speed up your workflow, including LoveArt and Google AI Studio. However, we’re looking for someone who has strong design skills and can use Photoshop when thumbnails require additional editing, compositing, or refinement.



Pay:

???? $40–$60 per month with potential for increases based on performance

???? 9 thumbnails per week initially, with more work/channels available based on performance



Responsibilities:

Create high-converting, scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails for our Youtube channels.

Use LoveArt and Google AI Studio to assist with thumbnail creation and visual concepts.

Edit and refine AI-generated images using Photoshop when needed.

Follow each channel’s established thumbnail style, branding, and visual guidelines.

Create thumbnails that match the topic, title, emotion, and story of each video.

Create visual content for LinkedIn posts and carousel images.

Collaborate with the team to improve designs and ensure content matches our creative direction.

Deliver final files in the correct size, format, and quality.

Organize thumbnail files and other visual assets properly in Google Drive.



Requirements:

Proven experience creating YouTube thumbnails.

Good Photoshop skills — this is important as some thumbnails will require manual editing.

Good understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, contrast, and text readability.

Experience using AI image/design tools such as LoveArt, Google AI Studio, Midjourney, or similar.

Able to combine AI-generated assets with Photoshop editing to create polished final thumbnails.

Strong understanding of what makes a thumbnail clickable.

Creative, detail-oriented, and able to follow an established visual style.

Able to work independently and consistently meet deadlines.

Good English communication skills.



Nice to Have:

Experience designing thumbnails for movie, entertainment, or YouTube automation channels.

Experience creating LinkedIn graphics and carousel posts.

Familiarity with CTR optimization and A/B testing.

Experience analyzing successful thumbnails and using those insights to improve designs.

Ability to create original thumbnail concepts rather than simply following templates.



Tools We Provided:

LoveArt AI

Google AI Studio

Brand templates, fonts, and design guidelines

Google Drive for file organization



You don’t need to pay for these AI tools yourself. We will provide access to the tools needed for the work.



Application Instructions:

If you’ve read the full job description, please include:



Links to your best YouTube thumbnail designs or portfolio.

Examples of thumbnails you personally created using Photoshop.

Examples of any AI-assisted designs you have created, if available.

A brief description of your experience with AI design tools.



Applications without thumbnail samples or a portfolio will not be considered.



We’re looking for someone who can become a long-term part of the team, with the opportunity to handle more channels and more work based on performance.

title: MEDIA BUYER | GOOGLE ADS + TAG MANAGER + TRACKING
description:
MEDIA BUYER | GOOGLE ADS + TAG MANAGER + TRACKING | PART TIME INTERNAL ROLE



$9 USD/hour to start | 10 hours per week | Long-term | Internal Legacy Growth team role





JOB OVERVIEW



This is not a client placement. You would be joining the Legacy Growth team directly and working alongside our founders on paid media across our client accounts.



We are looking for a seasoned media buyer who wants a focused part time role with a team that will actually respect your expertise. You will not be handed a checklist. You will own the paid side, tell us what you are seeing, and tell us when we are wrong.



Google Ads is the requirement. Meta is a plus.



We need someone who genuinely knows Google Ads, not someone who has run a few campaigns inside a dashboard. Just as important, we need someone who understands everything sitting underneath the campaign. When a conversion stops firing, when tags break after a site change, when the numbers in the ad account do not match the numbers in the CRM, you should know where to look and be able to fix it yourself.



You should have advanced, repeated, hands on experience with Google Ads campaign builds and Google Tag Manager setups. Not once. Several times, for real clients, from scratch.



The technical side matters as much as the buying side. That includes Google Tag Manager container builds, GA4, conversion tracking and enhanced conversions, event setup, tracking that connects the ad account to a CRM, and diagnosing tracking that has silently broken. If your answer to a broken tag is to ask someone else to look at it, this is not the right role.



Reliability is the other half of this job. Ten hours a week does not mean ten hours in one sitting. We need you present and responsive five days a week, because ad accounts do not wait. Spend does not pause while someone is offline. We need someone who checks in consistently, flags problems the same day, and never goes quiet.



We are looking for someone to start as early as September 1.





WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Building, launching, and managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts.



Google Tag Manager container setup, conversion tracking, and GA4 configuration.



Troubleshooting tracking, tags, conversions, and integrations when they break.



Monitoring spend and performance, and adjusting before problems compound rather than after.



Reporting clearly on what is working, what is not, and what you recommend changing.



Working directly with our founders on strategy and account decisions.



Meta ads work as a secondary responsibility if that is in your skill set.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



At least 5 years of hands on paid advertising experience.



Deep Google Ads expertise. This is not negotiable for this role.



Advanced Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking experience, done repeatedly for real clients.



Strong troubleshooting instincts across the full tracking stack, not just the ad platform.



Meta ads experience. This is a plus, not a requirement.



Reliable presence and responsiveness five days a week.



Strong written and spoken English and genuine comfort communicating with U.S. clients and founders.



Availability to start as early as September 1.





ABOUT LEGACY GROWTH



Legacy Growth Consulting is a U.S. based marketing and technology agency with a distributed team across the U.S. and Philippines. We build marketing ecosystems, content engines, and systems for coaches, consultants, and service based businesses.



This role sits on our internal team, not with a single client. You would be working across our accounts alongside our founders and our existing team of strategists, builders, and creatives.



We care about skill, but we also care deeply about communication, honesty, initiative, ownership, and finding people we genuinely want to work with long-term. We want someone who grows with us.





HOW TO APPLY



Please DO NOT apply through OnlineJobs.ph.



Apply here:



legacygrowth.life/ph



After applying,
 
 with the subject "Google Ads Media Buyer."



In that
, please send us all of the following:



A live link to your resume. Check the link works and is set to public before you send it.



A live link to your portfolio or case studies.



Your years of Google Ads experience and your years of Meta Ads experience, listed separately.



Examples of ad accounts you have managed. Tell us the industry, the monthly spend you were responsible for, and what results you produced.



A specific description of Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking setups you have built from scratch, including what you configured and what platforms you connected.

Your

We are hiring now and will move quickly for the right person.

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator, Level 3 (Part-Time)
description:
Part-Time Microsoft 365 IT Technician - Level 3

Architecture & Security Operations



About the role

RankStudio is hiring a part-time Level 3 Microsoft 365 IT Technician to own architecture and security operations for a growing portfolio of small biotech and pharma client environments. This is a hands-on, senior technical role -  not a ticket-support seat. You will design and implement M365 architecture, own security operations end-to-end, and build the automation that keeps client environments compliant and secure. You will work independently under the direction of RankStudio's CEO, who serves as the senior technical advisor across all engagements.



This role is designed for an experienced practitioner with an existing day job, freelance practice, or flexible schedule who wants meaningful architecture work at a boutique AI consulting firm. It is not a full-time seat, and it is not a bridge to full-time employment.



What you will own:

.Architecture - Design Microsoft 365 tenant configurations, security baselines, and compliance postures for biotech and pharma clients across 5-15 client environments. You own the design; the CEO reviews it.

Security operations - Own vulnerability management, i
 response, and security posture monitoring across client tenants. Not alert triage as a ticket-taker -  SecOps as the responsible technician.

Infrastructure as code - Build and maintain Bicep, ARM, or Terraform templates for repeatable tenant deployments. Version-controlled in GitHub. Reviewed for consistency across client environments.

PowerShell automation -  Write PowerShell scripts and Microsoft Graph SDK workflows from scratch for tenant configuration, user lifecycle, license management, security policy deployment, and compliance reporting. This is a build role, not a run-existing-scripts role.

Microsoft Purview architecture -  Design and deploy sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention schedules, eDiscovery workflows, and Insider Risk Management for regulated clients (21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA).

Entra ID architecture - Design conditional access frameworks, PIM configurations, access review cycles, and identity governance for client tenants.

Intune deployment architecture - Design BYOD and corporate device management approaches including App Protection Policies for regulated data on personal devices. Deploy compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app management workflows.

Defender for Endpoint and Defender for O365 - Own policy design, tuning, and i
 response ownership. Not queue watching.

Documentation -  Author architecture decision records, runbooks, and configuration baselines that other technicians can operate from.



Required experience:

4+ years hands-on M365 tenant administration, at least 2 of which in a managed services or multi-tenant consulting context.

PowerShell scripting from scratch - you can sit down and write a working script for an M365 admin task without starting from a template or AI-generated skeleton. You use documentation and AI tools to accelerate your work, but the underlying capability is yours.

Infrastructure as code exposure -  you have deployed at least one production environment (Azure resources, M365 baselines, or comparable) via Bicep, ARM, Terraform, or M365 DSC, and can explain the trade-offs of the tool you used.

Hands-on Intune -  you have deployed compliance policies, configuration profiles, and App Protection Policies (MAM without enrollment) in production.

Hands-on Entra ID / Azure AD - you have designed conditional access frameworks, deployed PIM, and run access reviews in production.

Working Purview knowledge -  you have deployed sensitivity labels, DLP policies, or retention schedules in production. Purview forensics-only experience (eDiscovery for hard-deleted data) does not qualify.

Security operations ownership -  you have owned vulnerability remediation, security i
 response, or compliance posture for at least one production environment as the responsible technician, not as a ticket-response contributor.

Excellent written English - has good writing and communications skills

Reliable home internet (50 Mbps minimum) and a personal computer capable of running M365 admin centers and a virtual desktop.



Strongly preferred:

Microsoft certifications - MS-102, SC-300, SC-400, AZ-104, AZ-500, MD-102. Full stack not required; two or three genuine, in-date certs are stronger signal than a long list of stale ones.

Past role at a Microsoft Partner or MSP serving SMB or mid-market clients across multiple tenants.

Experience with M365 backup tooling - Veeam M365, AvePoint, Druva, or Spanning.

Healthcare or life sciences client experience - 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, or GxP compliance context.

Ticketing systems-  Freshdesk, Zendesk, ConnectWise, or HaloPSA administration (as the person configuring the tool, not the person filling tickets in it).

Workflow automation exposure - n8n, Power Automate, or Logic Apps for admin task automation.



Disqualifiers:

Primary career experience is ticket / desk / support work, even if the resume shows M365 admin-center exposure. This role is architecture and SecOps ownership. Section titles matter: "IT Service Desk Analyst," "Technical Support Engineer," "Help Desk Technician" as the dominant career pattern will not fit, regardless of how the current job is titled.

Cannot write PowerShell without templates or AI-generated skeletons. AI-assisted scripting is expected. Inability to write from scratch is disqualifying - the role requires building automation others will run.

No production infrastructure-as-code experience. Training or self-study on IaC is not sufficient.

No hands-on Intune configuration profile or App Protection Policy deployment. Reading Microsoft Learn on Intune is not the same as deploying it.

Purview knowledge limited to eDiscovery forensics. The role requires deploying labels, DLP, and retention — governance, not just search.

Cannot commit to consistent weekly hours during Pacific business hours overlap. The role is asynchronous but requires reliable availability during the overlap window.

Requires this role as primary income. The compensation and hours are structured for candidates with an existing income base.



Engagement and pay

Independent contractor agreement

100% Remote

Part-time commitment: 20 hours per week, flexible scheduling with required overlap during Pacific business hours (specific overlap window to be agreed with the CEO).

Fixed monthly retainer: USD 900 to 1,000 per month, paid in USD via Wise.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote)



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



Stone Creation is a rapidly growing luxury stone fabrication and installation company based in Irvine, California. We specialize in high-end residential and commercial projects, including quartz, porcelain, natural stone, fireplaces, wall cladding, and custom architectural stonework.



We are looking for an exceptional Project Manager who will oversee projects from contract through final installation while ensuring every customer receives an outstanding experience.

This is not a position for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for a proactive, organized, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of their work, communicates exceptionally well, and enjoys solving problems before they happen.

____



About You

You are someone who:

- Takes ownership of every project.

- Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Communicates professionally and confidently with customers and team members.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment.

- Learns new software and processes quickly.

- Can prioritize multiple projects without missing deadlines.

- Thinks ahead and identifies potential issues before they become problems.

- Is resourceful, dependable, and accountable.

- Continuously looks for ways to improve systems and processes.

____



Responsibilities

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating projects from the time the contract is signed until the project is successfully completed.

Responsibilities include:

- Managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Coordinating project schedules with customers and field personnel.

- Scheduling templating, fabrication, deliveries, and installations.

- Communicating with customers throughout every stage of the project.

- Coordinating with sales, templators, fabricators, installers, and subcontractors.

- Reviewing project documentation for accuracy before production.

- Following up on customer approvals and outstanding items.

- Tracking project progress daily and ensuring deadlines are met.

- Identifying scheduling conflicts and resolving issues proactively.

- Maintaining accurate project notes and documentation.

- Ensuring all projects follow Stone Creation's internal procedures and quality standards.

- Providing exceptional customer service from start to finish.

____



Qualifications

Required

- Previous experience managing construction projects or stone fabrication/tile projects.

- Experience in the stone, tile, cabinetry, kitchen & bath, General Construction, or remodeling industry.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Outstanding organizational and time management skills.

- Strong customer service and communication skills.

- Ability to multitask and manage multiple deadlines.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

-- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Highly proficient with computers and learning new software.

____



Preferred

- Software Experience

- Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- Any construction management platform whether stone based or GC based

- Slack

- Microsoft Office

- Google Workspace

- Zoom



Don't worry if you haven't used every program—we're looking for someone who learns quickly.

____



What Success Looks Like

Our ideal Project Manager:

- Keeps projects moving without being reminded.

-Anticipates problems before they affect the customer.

-Communicates proactively with customers and the internal team.

- Maintains accurate schedules and documentation.

- Takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Helps improve our processes as the company continues to grow.

____



What We Offer

- Full-time, long-term employment.

- Opportunity for growth within a rapidly expanding company.

- Performance-based raises.

- Paid time off.

- Ongoing training and development.

A supportive team environment where your ideas and contributions matter.

We are building a team for the long term and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.

____



How to Apply

Please submit:

- Your resume.

- A short introduction about yourself.

- Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

- A brief description of the most challenging project you've managed and how you successfully handled it.

Important: To show that you pay attention to detail, please include the words "Stone PM Ready" as the first line of your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We look forward to welcoming an exceptional Project Manager to the Stone Creation team.

title: Sales Call Center Director (New York #1 Med Spa Business)
description:
Call Center / Sales Development Director — High Performance Appointment Setting Team (Med Spa)



Position: Remote

Type: Full-time

Compensation: $1800/month Base Salary + up to $1000 Bonus (per Month)



We're one of New York's fastest-growing aesthetics companies. We have 5 locations in New York, and are expanding to 20 locations by the end of 2027.



We run advertising at scale, and every lead that comes in is greeted by our appointment-setting team within minutes. This team is the engine of the business — and we're looking for the person who will run it.



This is not a role where you manage a queue and file reports. You will live in the call recordings, the dial data, and the conversion metrics. You will know within a week which setter is fumbling the price objection, which script line is killing bookings, and which hour of the day we're leaving money on the table. Then you'll fix it.



If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed with a 3-point lift in book rate, keep reading.



What You'll Own:



Coaching & Development



Run daily huddles and weekly 1:1s with every setter

Listen to and score calls every single day; deliver specific, recorded-example-based feedback

Build and maintain a call-scoring scorecard covering opening, discovery, objection handling, urgency, and close

Own onboarding and ramp for new setters — get new hires to full productivity fast, with a documented ramp plan

Side-by-side and live-listen coaching; roleplay objections until they're automatic



Performance Management:



Own the team's KPIs and report on them daily: dials, contact rate, set rate, show rate, and setter-sourced revenue

Identify underperformance early, build written improvement plans, and follow through — including tough calls on who stays

Run performance rankings and make coaching time proportional to opportunity, not seniority

Partner with leadership on incentive design, contests, and spiffs that actually change behavior



Operations & Scripts:



Own the scripts, rebuttals, voi
 templates, and SMS/follow-up cadences — and A/B test them relentlessly

Manage a 24/7 coverage schedule across a mix of US-based and offshore team members, including nights and weekends

Monitor speed-to-lead and hold the team to a minutes-not-hours standard on new inquiries

Keep CRM hygiene tight: disposition accuracy, pipeline stage integrity, no lead left untouched

Work directly with marketing on lead quality feedback, and with clinic/closing teams on smooth handoffs



Hiring & Team Building:



Recruit, interview, and hire setters as we scale

Build a culture people want to compete inside of — high standards, real recognition, zero drama



How You'll Be Measured:



Appointments set per setter, per day

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

Show rate on booked appointments

Speed-to-lead (time from opt-in to first dial)

Setter-sourced revenue

Team retention and ramp time for new hires

You'll have a dashboard. You'll defend those numbers weekly. And when they move in the right direction, you'll get the credit.



Who You Are



Required:



5+ years managing or supervising an outbound sales, appointment-setting, inside sales, or high-volume contact center team

A track record you can actually talk through in numbers — "I took set rate from X to Y in Z months"

Genuinely strong at coaching: you can pull up a call, diagnose the miss in 30 seconds, and give feedback that sticks

Comfortable in a CRM and dialer environment; you build your own reports rather than waiting on someone else's

Data-literate — pivot tables, conversion math, and cohort comparisons don't scare you

title: Technical SEO Specialist (E-Commerce)
description:
We're looking for a **Technical SEO Specialist** to own organic search and AI search visibility for a data-first growth marketing agency serving e-commerce brands. You will work directly on technical audits, on-page optimization, content strategy, and AI answer engine optimization across a focused portfolio of e-commerce clients, with the goal of driving non-brand traffic, AI citation presence, and measurable revenue contribution.



This is a high-output, analytically rigorous role. The agency operates with a bottom-line obsession — every SEO initiative needs to connect to revenue, not just rankings. You will be expected to think like an operator, not just a technician. If you understand both the technical and editorial sides of SEO, can tie your work directly to business outcomes, and stay ahead of how AI platforms are changing how buyers discover brands, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Work inside a data-first agency with a rigorous analytical culture and a focused, high-quality client roster

- High-ownership SEO role where your work is measured against real revenue impact, not vanity metrics



## What You'll Work On



**Technical SEO Audits and Implementation**



- Conduct comprehensive technical audits covering crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, and page speed

- Identify and resolve issues affecting organic visibility including redirect chains, duplicate content, canonicalization, and structured data errors

- Implement and optimize schema markup for products, reviews, FAQs, and AI answer engines

- Audit on-page fundamentals including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, and image optimization

- Prioritize fixes by revenue impact and translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations



**E-Commerce SEO**



- Optimize category pages, product pages, and collection structures for organic search performance and conversion

- Develop keyword strategies aligned with buyer intent across the full e-commerce funnel

- Support site migrations, platform changes, and redesigns with a clear SEO preservation plan

- Collaborate with development and design teams to ensure SEO requirements are implemented correctly



**AI Answer Engine Optimization**



- Develop strategies to get clients cited and recommended in AI-generated responses across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude

- Structure content with clear definitional formats, comparison frameworks, and direct-answer layouts that AI models surface

- Monitor AI platform presence and citation rates and adjust content strategy based on findings

- Stay ahead of how AI search behavior is evolving and bring proactive recommendations to the team



**Content Strategy and Production Support**



- Build and manage content calendars targeting non-brand organic keywords and AI-answer queries

- Brief or write content that ranks, earns citations, and supports the buyer journey from awareness through conversion

- Identify content gaps across client sites and prioritize based on traffic potential, competition, and revenue opportunity



**Reporting and Analytics**



- Report on organic traffic, keyword rankings, CTR, Core Web Vitals, AI citation presence, and revenue contribution

- Connect SEO performance to bottom-line outcomes using available analytics data

- Translate data into clear insights and prioritized next steps for both internal teams and clients



## What You Bring



- Proven experience managing technical SEO for e-commerce websites that generate organic traffic and revenue

- Strong technical SEO skills including the ability to run a full audit, identify root causes, and implement fixes

- Deep understanding of e-commerce site architecture including category hierarchies, faceted navigation, product page optimization, and pagination

- Familiarity with how AI answer engines work and what it takes to get content cited and surfaced

- Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent

- Analytically rigorous with the ability to connect SEO work directly to revenue outcomes

- Comfortable working independently across multiple client accounts without losing quality or missing deadlines

- Strong written communication skills for client-facing reporting and internal documentation



## Nice to Have



- Experience with Shopify, BigCommerce, or similar e-commerce platforms at a technical level

- Familiarity with AI visibility tools such as Scrunch AI, Profound, or similar platforms

- Background in performance marketing or growth analytics alongside SEO

- Experience supporting site migrations or platform transitions with zero organic traffic loss

- Prior agency experience managing SEO across multiple e-commerce client accounts simultaneously



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **link to 2 to 3 examples of SEO work** you owned including the URL, the target keyword or initiative, and the measurable outcome

3. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, walking through one technical SEO or AIO win you are proud of, and explaining how you connected it to a business outcome



**Only candidates who submit both work examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

title: Accountant

?

?

?



Education

	•	Additional coursework or certification in transportation or logistics accounting is a plus.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Arnold & Sons Plumbing, Sewer & Drain is a family-owned residential service company located in Central Illinois. For more than 35 years, we have helped customers through plumbing and sewer problems, often on days when things are not going as planned.



Our mission is:



“Positively impacting our community through meaningful experiences.”



Our core values spell ARNOLD:



* Appreciation: Recognize the value of contributions

* Responsible: Be accountable

* Nurture: Foster healthy relationships

* Optimistic: Show positivity

* Leadership: Inspire others through example

* Dedication: Have enduring commitment



We are looking for a dependable, positive, and caring Customer Service Representative in the Philippines to join our team remotely. You will often be the first person our customers speak with, so your ability to listen, communicate clearly, and make people feel cared for is extremely important.



About the Position



As a Remote Customer Service Representative, you will answer incoming calls from customers who need plumbing, sewer, or drain service. You will gather accurate information, help customers feel confident in choosing our company, and schedule service appointments based on our procedures.



You do not need to know everything about plumbing when you begin. We will provide training. What we cannot teach is a positive attitude, personal accountability, genuine care for people, and a strong desire to improve.



Primary Responsibilities



* Answer incoming customer calls professionally, warmly, and promptly

* Listen carefully and show empathy for customers experiencing stressful situations

* Ask the right questions to understand the customer’s needs

* Schedule and accurately book service appointments

* Clearly explain what customers can expect from our company

* Build positive rapport with every caller

* Enter complete and accurate customer information into our service software

* Update customer records during and after each interaction

* Follow established scripts, processes, and company policies

* Communicate with dispatchers, managers, and field team members

* Return customer calls and assist with questions or concerns

* Participate in weekly training and coaching

* Continue learning about our services and improving your call-handling skills

* Help turn first-time customers into long-term customers through an excellent experience



What We Are Looking For



* Strong spoken and written English

* A clear, friendly, and confident phone voice

* Previous customer service, call center, appointment-setting, or home-service experience

* Excellent listening and communication skills

* Genuine empathy and patience with customers

* Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry

* Ability to follow processes while still sounding natural and conversational

* Comfortable receiving coaching, feedback, and ongoing training

* Dependable attendance and punctuality

* Ability to remain calm and professional during busy or challenging calls

* Personal accountability and consistent follow-through

* A positive attitude and a willingness to help the entire team succeed

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision



Experience with ServiceTitan or a U.S.-based home-service company is helpful, but not required.



Remote Work Requirements



* A reliable computer capable of running our required programs

* High-speed and dependable internet service

* A backup internet option in case of an outage

* A quality noise-canceling headset

* A quiet and professional workspace without background noise

* Reliable electricity and a backup plan for power interruptions

* Ability to work full-time during assigned U.S. Central Time hours

* Ability to attend virtual meetings, training sessions, and coaching



What You Can Expect From Us



* Thorough training on our company, services, and customer service standards

* Weekly coaching and continued development

* Clear expectations and consistent feedback

* A supportive team that values communication and accountability

* The opportunity to build a stable, long-term role with a growing company

* The chance to make a meaningful difference for customers every day



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé

2. A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position

3. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service experience

4. Your previous experience working U.S. hours, if applicable

5. Your current internet speed and backup internet and power options

6. Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos



Please begin your application with the words “Meaningful Experiences” so we know you carefully read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who wants more than a temporary online job. We want a dependable teammate who takes pride in helping customers, welcomes coaching, and wants to grow with our company.

Full-time. Must work US Eastern business hours (about 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET). For most of the Philippines this is an evening/overnight shift -- please only apply if that schedule genuinely works for you long-term.



ABOUT US

We're a busy South Florida aesthetics and med-spa practice -- injectables, laser, skin treatments, and more (we're part of a dermatology practice, so there's a medical side too, but this role is all about our cosmetic and med-spa services). People call and message us every day curious about these treatments, and a lot of them just need a warm, confident person to answer their questions and get them on the schedule. That's the job.
