We need a hybrid designer + builder who can take a strategy document, sales copy, and brand assets and turn them into a fully built, conversion-optimized site or funnel. You'll design in Figma when needed, but most days you're building directly inside GoHighLevel and Shopify, with occasional work in Webflow, Kajabi, ThriveCart, or WordPress.



You'll work on 3-6 active client builds at a time, alongside our strategist, copywriter, and AI/automation team. You are the person who makes the plan real on the screen.



What you'll actually do

Build client sales funnels inside GoHighLevel — sales pages, VSL pages, opt-ins, checkouts, thank-you pages, upsells, calendar pages, and forms



Build and customize Shopify storefronts — themes, product pages, collections, custom sections, checkout tweaks, app integrations



Design in Figma when a client needs mockups before build, or when we're pitching a concept



Translate finished copy and strategy docs into laid-out, on-brand pages that convert



Adapt each client's brand system (fonts, palette, imagery, tone) into every page consistently



Optimize builds for mobile, page speed, accessibility, and clean visual hierarchy



Coordinate with our automation team so pages connect properly to CRM,
, payment, and community platforms



QA every build against our internal checklist before handoff



Occasionally build in Webflow, Framer, Kajabi, ThriveCart, MemberVault, or WordPress as client needs require



You're a strong fit if you have

3+ years professional experience designing AND building websites/funnels for real clients



Deep GoHighLevel experience — you can build a full funnel in GHL without hand-holding, including forms, workflows, and calendar embeds



Strong Shopify experience — theme customization, Liquid basics, app setup, product/collection page design



Solid Figma skills for design work when it's needed before build



A portfolio that shows range: sales pages, service sites, e-comm stores, and course/membership platforms



Excellent taste in typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy — you can spot when something feels off and fix it



Fluent written and spoken English — you'll be reading strategy docs, copy briefs, and client feedback



Comfort working async across time zones with Slack, Loom, Google Drive, and project trackers



Reliable internet, a machine that can handle Figma + design tools, and a professional remote setup



Nice-to-haves

Experience with Webflow, Framer, Kajabi, ThriveCart, MemberVault, or WordPress



Basic HTML/CSS for custom tweaks inside GHL and Shopify



Familiarity with GA4, Meta Pixel, and basic tracking setup



Experience building for coaches, course creators, service providers, or DTC product brands



Comfort with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney) for asset generation and workflow acceleration



What we care about

Speed with polish. We move fast, but we don't ship sloppy.



Ownership. You take a build from brief to launch. You don't wait to be told what to fix.



Brand fidelity. Every client's aesthetic is sacred. Your job is to serve their brand, not yours.



Conversion mindset. Pretty is table stakes. Does it convert is the real question.



Communication. Overcommunicate progress, blockers, and questions. We don't do black boxes.



Compensation & structure

Full-time contractor, 40 hrs/week, paid monthly



Rate negotiated based on portfolio, experience, and trial project performance



Paid trial project (one small build, paid at your quoted rate) before offer is finalized



Long-term relationship — we're hiring a keeper, not a task-rabbit



Growth path: senior designer/builder, then design lead as we scale the team



How to apply

Apply here: 



Complete the full application form at the link above. 

Applications submitted anywhere other than the form above will not be reviewed. Applications without portfolio links or without GHL experience will not be reviewed.



The Digital Doula is operated by Elya Consulting LLC. We work with clients across the US, EU, and Australia. All contractor agreements are handled via written contract with clear scope, deliverables, and payment terms.

title: Construction Project Coordinator
description:
upports the senior PM and site superintendent in delivering commercial interior fit-outs and tenant improvements from award through closeout. Owns the administrative and logistical backbone of the project: subcontractor and supplier coordination, purchase orders, submittals and shop drawings, RFIs, change order tracking, permit and inspection scheduling, and maintaining the project schedule and document controls. Acts as the day-to-day communication link between site, office, clients, consultants, and trades — chasing outstanding items, keeping drawings and revisions current, and flagging schedule or cost risks early. Also assists with site meeting minutes, progress photo/report packages, safety documentation, and deficiency lists through to final handover.



Typically 2–5 years in commercial construction, strong in scheduling and document management software (Procore/Bluebeam/MS Project or similar), comfortable reading drawings and specs, and organized enough to keep several active fit-outs moving at once.

title: Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)
description:
Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)

Company: Accommos Ltd (brands: Accommos, Staymodu, Glowhouse Wellness Stays)

Location: Fully remote — UK business hours (9:00–17:30 GMT/BST)

Type: Full-time contractor 

Compensation: £1,000–£1,400/month base + uncapped commission on incremental revenue + occupancy bonus 

Reports to: Founder / Director



About Accommos

Accommos is a premium, tech-led short-term rental management company operating a portfolio of design-focused apartments across London. Our properties stand apart through wellness amenities — private saunas, cold plunges, hot tubs and cinema rooms — and a strict quality-first operating model. We hold Airbnb Superhost status and run on a modern stack: Guesty, PriceLabs, Enso Connect and heavily automated internal systems.

We are now building the commercial side of the business, and this role owns it end to end: pricing strategy, demand generation, B2B channels, ancillary revenue and guest lifetime value.



The Role

This is not a lead-sourcing or cold-calling position. You will be responsible for maximising total revenue per property across every lever available — rate, occupancy, length of stay, channel mix, ancillary income and repeat business. You will operate like a hotel revenue manager crossed with a commercial partnerships lead.

You will be the first dedicated commercial hire, working directly with the founder. You will have real autonomy, real data access, and compensation tied directly to the revenue you create.



What You Will Own

1. Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

 -Run event-led pricing: map London demand drivers (concert residencies, stadium

 events, conferences, school holidays, sporting fixtures) months ahead and position rates before the market moves

-Optimise length-of-stay rules: minimum-stay laddering, gap-night and orphan-night auto-discounting, check-in day restrictions that eliminate unsellable one-night gaps

-Segment pricing by demand pattern: mid-week corporate vs. weekend leisure vs. mid- stay relocation, with different rate strategies for each

-Manage the PriceLabs configuration against a monthly RevPAR target per property, not just occupancy

-Run controlled experiments: test rate positions, LOS rules and offer structures, and keep what wins



2. Relocation & Corporate Demand

-Build and manage relationships with relocation agencies, insurance temporary-housing providers, corporate travel bookers, film/TV production companies and serviced- apartment agents

-Register the portfolio with corporate booking agencies and respond to RFPs for corporate housing programmes

-Pursue insurance housing panel placements (temporary accommodation after floods, fires and building failures) — long stays, reliable payers

-Negotiate corporate rates that protect margin while securing the occupancy floor



3. B2B Distribution Channels

-Get the portfolio listed with serviced-apartment agencies and booking platforms that feed corporate demand

-Build direct relationships with travel management companies and executive assistants at Canary Wharf employers

-Develop a location-hire channel for photo and film shoots: agency outreach, rate card, availability process



4. Guest Upsells & Ancillary Revenue

-Design and refine upsell flows for early check-in, late checkout, mid-stay cleaning, extended stays and wellness add-ons through Enso Connect

-Build packaged offers: wellness weekend packages, monthly-stay bundles, celebration set-ups — priced as products, not discounts

-Launch and manage gift vouchers and prepaid stay credits for the direct site Track attach rates per upsell and continuously improve timing, pricing and copy



5. Direct Booking Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

-Grow bookings on our direct website (
), working alongside our paid-ads freelancer

-Own the guest database: post-stay win-back campaigns, seasonal offers to past guests, and a repeat-guest recognition programme that shifts OTA guests to direct

-Build a referral mechanism for guests and corporate contacts

-Recapture lost demand: cancelled bookings, expired quotes and abandoned direct-site sessions get structured follow-up offers

-Improve on-site conversion through offers, copy and booking-journey feedback



6. Occupancy Gap-Filling

-Monitor the portfolio calendar weekly; identify soft periods 2–6 weeks out and act before they arrive

-Sell gaps proactively: outreach to corporate contacts, targeted past-guest offers, location-hire placements, strategic LOS relaxation

-Coordinate all tactics with the pricing strategy so gap-filling never erodes the rate position



KPIs

-RevPAR per property vs. target (the headline metric)

-Incremental revenue generated per month, by stream

-Portfolio occupancy vs. baseline, with rate integrity maintained

-Direct booking share vs. OTA share

-Upsell attach rate and ancillary revenue per booking

-Repeat-guest rate and guest database growth

-Number of active corporate/relocation/agency accounts producing bookings



What We Are Looking For



Must have

-3+ years in revenue management, commercial or business development within short- term rentals, serviced apartments, hotels, corporate housing or relocation services

-Demonstrable record of revenue you personally generated or grew — you will be asked for specifics and numbers

-Working command of revenue metrics: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, LOS, channel contribution, attach rate

-Excellent spoken and written English; confident and credible on calls with UK corporate clients and agents

-Consultative selling style: you listen, diagnose and propose — you do not script-read Comfortable running structured experiments and reading the results honestly Reliable remote setup: quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet

-Available during UK business hours



Strongly preferred

-Hands-on experience with dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond) and a PMS (Guesty or comparable)

-Existing knowledge of the London accommodation market and its event calendar

-Familiarity with relocation agents, insurance housing, TMCs or serviced-apartment agencies


/CRM lifecycle marketing experience



Compensation Structure

-Base: £1,000–£1,400/month depending on experience

-Commission: percentage of incremental revenue across corporate bookings, upsells, ancillary income and direct bookings (structure shared at interview; uncapped)

-Quarterly RevPAR bonus when the portfolio exceeds target

-Realistic year-one on-target earnings: £20,000–£30,000+



Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention

-Ground-floor commercial hire in a profitable, growing company — you build the function

-Direct line to the founder; decisions in days, not quarters

-A genuinely differentiated product to sell: wellness-led properties that photograph well, review well and command premium rates

-Full access to the levers: pricing, channels, partnerships, marketing — not a narrow patch

-Compensation that scales with the results you deliver



How to Apply

Begin your application with the word “sauna” so we know you read this far. Then include:

1. Your CV

2. A short note (max 200 words) describing one specific piece of revenue you personally created or grew — what it was, how you did it, and the number

3. A voice recording (1–2 minutes, Vocaroo or similar) introducing yourself as if leaving a voi
 for a relocation agent you want to work with



Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone.

To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: E-commerce Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor specializing in Meta Ads for physical products and dropshipping? Can you look at a competitor’s winning ad and immediately understand how to replicate it technically, or transform a script into a winning creative using the most advanced AI tools? If you answered an enthusiastic “YES” to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and education space and we’re looking for a Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist) to join our creative team.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Crafting clean, high-conversion ads (1 to 5 minutes) including Mini-VSLs, AI-UGC, and "Product in Hand" content.

Asset Management & Sourcing: You will be provided with a folder of our selected B-rolls. However, if additional clips are needed, you must source them autonomously and innovatively. The use of traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

From Script to Finished Product: We provide the scripts; your job is to interpret them visually, choosing the right clips and editing them to create a dynamic, persuasive, and technically flawless product.

AI Tool Research & Implementation: This is your passion. You must stay constantly updated on new AI releases (editing, UGC avatars, video generation). In our weekly calls, we expect you to pitch new software that can revolutionize our workflow.

AI Asset Generation: Hands-on use of the AI Stack (Higgsfield, Sora 2, Veo 3, Arcads, MakeUGC) to create or enhance content.

Visual Optimization: Implementing textual hooks, kinetic typography, and scroll-stopping subtitles.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific experience: A solid background in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands. You must have worked as an editor for brands generating at least $10k/month in revenue. While respecting privacy, you will be asked to provide examples of these collaborations in the following stages.

Deep Passion for Innovation: This isn't just a job; you must love technology. We want an AI "killer" who stays ahead of the market.

Excellent Problem-Solving Skills: If instructions aren't crystal clear or assets are missing, you don't stop. You find a solution and complete the task with excellence.

Availability & Commitment: Starting with a part-time collaboration (20h/week) with a clear intention of moving to Full-Time shortly. We work 5 days a week, but availability on Saturdays and Sundays is required for emergencies. Please note: we are looking for a dedicated partner, not an "Upwork or Fiverr style" freelancer juggling 5-6 different companies. If you cannot guarantee us top priority and absolute mental focus, do not apply.

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: Subtitles, cuts, and details must be perfect. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

Fluent in English: The team communicates in English. Deep proficiency is mandatory to manage multilingual content (IT, FR, ES, DE, NL).

What We Offer:

Performance Bonuses: Potential for bonuses up to $1000+ per month based on the results of the videos produced.

Career Growth: A real opportunity to become Head of Video Editing.

Active Involvement: You will actively participate in the growth of an international company, testing the most powerful AI tools on the market.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: Social Media Ad Designer / Creative Monster
description:
Hi social media addict ????



Yes, we mean you.



The person who spends way too much time scrolling Instagram, TikTok,
 and 
.



Who notices weird ads.



Saves clever creatives.



Sees a meme and immediately thinks: “This could actually be an ad.”



And who understands why some ads make you stop scrolling… while others disappear into the feed.



We are looking for a creative / social media monster who can help us take our ads to the next level.



Not just someone who knows Canva or Photoshop.



And definitely not someone who takes a template, changes the colors and calls it a day.



We’re looking for someone who understands advertising.



Someone who can take an idea from us and turn it into something that makes people stop, look and understand the message within seconds.



One VERY important thing:



You need to understand the Dutch / European advertising style.



Dutch ads are often cleaner, more direct, more subtle and less “salesy”.



Typography matters.



Spacing matters.



Photography matters.



The words you emphasize matter.



We need someone who sees the difference between something that feels natural in the feed and something that immediately screams “advertisement”.



You don't necessarily need to have worked for a Dutch company before.



But you do need to be able to study our market, understand our references and adapt your design style to it.



What will you create?



Mostly social media ads for
 and Instagram.



And we like experimenting.



One day it might be a clean ad.



The next day:



* A fake WhatsApp conversation

* A handwritten note

* A timer inside a work van

* A meme

* A Reddit-style post

* A screenshot-style creative

* A realistic AI-generated scene

* Or something completely new



The concept comes first.



We don't want every ad to look like an advertisement.



Some of our best-performing ads don't.



How we work



Most of the time, we come up with the marketing concept.



For example:



“We want to show a mechanic sitting in his van with a timer counting down until he can finally go home.”



Your job isn't just to execute it.



We want your brain to start working too.



What should it look like?



What should someone notice first?



How do we make it believable?



Could the idea be even better?



We don't need an order taker.



We want a creative sparring partner.



You might be our person if…



* You regularly create social media ads

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You follow memes, trends, formats and advertising concepts

* You understand typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition

* You know how to use text without turning an ad into a flyer

* You understand that the prettiest ad isn't always the best-performing ad

* You have a strong eye for photography and realistic imagery

* You know when AI looks good and when it looks painfully fake

* You use Canva, Photoshop, Figma or similar tools

* You are comfortable using AI in your workflow

* You can work independently

* You aren't afraid to challenge an idea



Experience with Meta Ads or performance marketing is a big plus.



Things that make us cry



Please don't send us:



* Generic Canva templates

* Stock photo + giant headline + icons + logo

* Designs with six different fonts

* Creatives with 37 things fighting for attention

* Fake-looking AI people

* Perfect designs that communicate absolutely nothing

* Copies of other ads without understanding why they work



We love AI.



We use it ourselves every day.



But AI should make your creative work better.



It should never replace good taste.



About us



We create social media advertising campaigns for companies in the Netherlands.



Our job is to make people stop scrolling, understand a message quickly and take action.



You'll mainly work together with our Marketing Manager, who has been running Meta advertising campaigns for more than 10 years and loves testing new creative concepts.



We're informal, ambitious and constantly experimenting.



If something works, we improve it.



If something doesn't, we kill it and try something else.



No ego.



Just better ads.



Before you apply…



Please do NOT send us a portfolio full of logos, business cards, menus and PowerPoint presentations.



We're hiring you to make ads.



So we want to see ADS.



Send us 3–5 social media advertisements you personally designed.



Preferably work aimed at Dutch or European audiences.



For your strongest ad, briefly tell us:



Why do you think this one works?



We just want to understand how your brain works.



And one final thing:



Start your application with the word “Scrollstopper”.



That way we know you actually made it this far. ????



If you live and breathe social media, love making ads and think you can surprise us creatively…



We want to see your work.

title: PAYROLL, ACCOUNTING & BILLING CLERK – U.S. LAW FIRM**
description:
Rhythm & Reason Law, APC is seeking a highly organized, accurate, and dependable Payroll, Accounting & Billing Clerk for a long-term, full-time remote position.



**Compensation:** dependent on experience

**Hours:** 20/40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

**Review:** 90-Day Performance Review with opportunity for compensation growth



This position is ideal for someone with strong bookkeeping, billing, payroll, and administrative accounting skills who wants to become an important part of the financial operations of a growing U.S. law firm.



**RESPONSIBILITIES**



You will be responsible for supporting the firm's day-to-day financial and billing operations, including:

• Experience with invoicing and accounts receivable

• Exceptional numerical accuracy and attention to detail

• Excellent written English

• Ability to follow detailed written procedures and internal controls

What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

title: **FULL-TIME VIRTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANT — U.S. LAW FIRM**
description:
**Rhythm & Reason Law, APC** is seeking an experienced, highly organized, resourceful, and proactive **Virtual Legal Assistant** for a long-term, full-time remote position.



**Review:** 90-Day Performance Review with opportunity for compensation and professional growth



This is **not a general virtual-assistant or basic data-entry position.**



We are looking for a legal professional who can help make the firm **more organized, efficient, responsive, and productive.**



The ideal candidate has prior experience supporting U.S. attorneys or law firms and understands that excellent legal support requires initiative, accuracy, confidentiality, professional judgment, excellent written communication, and exceptional attention to detail.



**RESPONSIBILITIES**



The Virtual Legal Assistant will assist with:



• Managing and organizing electronic client and matter files

• Maintaining the firm's case-management system

• Preparing professional correspondence, letters, notices, and routine legal documents

• Formatting pleadings, agreements, and other legal documents

• Proofreading documents for grammar, formatting, completeness, and obvious inconsistencies

• Preparing documents and files for attorney review

• Organizing exhibits and supporting documentation

• Maintaining matter task lists, checklists, and workflows

• Monitoring deadlines and assisting with docket and calendar management

• Following up on outstanding tasks, documents, and information

• Conducting basic factual and administrative research

• Uploading and organizing documents in client portals

• Preparing client status communications for attorney approval

• Following up with clients for outstanding documents and information

• Assisting with client intake, onboarding, and matter opening

• Scheduling meetings and appointments

• Preparing internal reports concerning open matters, deadlines, and outstanding tasks

• Assisting with document preparation and electronic filing

• Closing and organizing completed client matters

• Supporting implementation of firm procedures and workflows

• Identifying administrative inefficiencies and helping improve firm processes

• Performing other legal and administrative duties assigned by the Principal Attorney



**SYSTEMS**



The firm utilizes systems including:



• MyCase

• Microsoft Word and Excel

• Gmail / Google Workspace

• Adobe Acrobat Pro

• Electronic client portals and cloud-based legal systems



Experience with **MyCase or another U.S. legal practice-management platform** is strongly preferred.



**QUALIFICATIONS**



Candidates should have:



• Prior legal assistant, legal secretary, paralegal, or comparable legal-support experience

• Strong preference for prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Excellent grammar, spelling, proofreading, and professional-writing skills

• Strong Microsoft Word and document-formatting skills

• Excellent organizational and electronic file-management skills

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple matters, assignments, and deadlines simultaneously

• Ability to follow detailed written procedures

• Strong judgment when handling confidential information

• Ability to work independently and proactively

• Ability to identify missing information and potential problems

• Ability to prioritize assignments appropriately

• Reliable computer equipment and internet connection



Experience involving **business law, employment law, civil litigation, contracts, estate planning/probate, real estate, or general civil matters** is a plus.



**THE PERSON WE WANT**



We are looking for someone who will contribute to the growth and efficiency of the firm—not simply maintain the status quo.



The successful candidate should be able to receive an assignment, understand its objective, review the available information, identify what is missing, follow established procedures, organize the work, and move the assignment toward completion without requiring constant supervision.



We expect thoughtful questions when necessary. However, we also value resourcefulness. Before asking a question, you should review the file, instructions, available resources, and prior communications to determine whether the answer is already available.



We want someone who eventually becomes the person the attorney can rely upon to know:



• What needs to be completed

• What information is missing

• What deadlines are approaching

• What is waiting on the client

• What is waiting on the attorney

• What administrative action should happen next



Professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, accuracy, initiative, and accountability are mandatory.



**WORK EXPECTATIONS**



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week professional position.



During scheduled paid working hours, you are expected to be actively performing work for Rhythm & Reason Law, APC and available as required by your assigned schedule.





All client information is confidential. Firm and client documents may not be copied, retained, transmitted, or used outside authorized firm systems.



**GROWTH OPPORTUNITY**



We are interested in developing a long-term relationship with an exceptional employee.



Candidates who demonstrate excellent performance, reliability, initiative, legal-administrative skills, and the ability to increase firm efficiency may receive increased responsibility and compensation following performance reviews.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Please provide:



1. Your resume.

2. A brief description of your legal experience.

3. The types of law firms or attorneys you have supported.

4. The practice areas in which you have experience.

5. The legal software and case-management systems you have used.

6. Your experience drafting, proofreading, or formatting legal documents.

7. Your available working hours.

8. Your expected monthly compensation.

title: Senior Graphic Designer — Amazon Creatives & Video (Long-Term)
description:
We are Goodcommerce, a German consumer-products company. We run five

brands on Amazon across Europe: fine stainless-steel jewellery, men's

accessory sets, preserved botanicals, and two design-led kids' toy

brands.



We are looking for one senior designer to own our visual output

long-term. Not per project, not for a few months. We would rather

find the right person once and keep them for years.



Two things before you read on, because they save us both time:



- There is NO unpaid test task. If your portfolio and your answers

  convince us, we go straight to a video call. We think asking

  designers to work for free is a bad way to start a relationship.

- We do read every application properly. But we only read the ones

  that follow the format at the bottom.



WHAT YOU WOULD OWN



- Amazon gallery images: infographics, feature callouts, size and

  scale visuals

- A+ Content modules: brand story, comparison charts, lifestyle

  modules

- Ad creatives for Sponsored Brands

- Short product videos for listings — editing and light motion

  graphics. We supply raw footage and product shots

- Keeping five brands visually consistent as our catalogue grows



You would be the only designer on our brands. Your work goes live and

directly moves our sales. Nobody will hand you a template to fill in.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are being specific on purpose. We would rather get twenty good

applications than two hundred generic ones.



You design for the customer, not for other designers. Our images are

judged at thumbnail size on a phone, in a search result, next to

fifteen competitors. Beautiful but unreadable is a fail for us. If

you have ever argued with someone about where the eye goes first in

an image, we will get along.



You can follow a brand guideline exactly. We have a written guideline

per brand — exact hex codes, exact fonts, defined image world. Exact

means exact. We recently had a designer recolour one of our logos

because he thought it looked better that way. That is the single

fastest way to not get this job.



You work independently. We give you the guideline, logo vectors,

product photos and a brief. We do not want to explain the basics

every week.



You tell us early. If something will be late, we want to know two

days before, not on the deadline. That alone puts you ahead of most

people.



REQUIRED

- 3+ years professional graphic design, with real e-commerce or

  marketplace work — Amazon strongly preferred

- Advanced Photoshop and Illustrator

- Video editing at listing-video level: Premiere or After Effects

- Written English good enough for detailed briefs and feedback

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and a quiet place to work



NICE TO HAVE — tell us if you have it, but it is not required

- Print-ready packaging: dielines, CMYK, bleed, prepress

- Amazon Seller Central experience

- Jewellery or kids' product categories



WHAT WE OFFER

- $1,000 - $1,300 per month, depending on what you can show us.

  Paid monthly via Wise, on the same date every month, on time

- Full-time and long-term. We are building a team, not filling a gap

- 13th month pay

- 15 days paid leave per year plus Philippine holidays

- No night shifts. We only need you online between 2 PM and 6 PM

  Manila time. The rest of your day is yours to organise

- A salary review after 6 months, and again after 12

- Real ownership of the work, and honest feedback instead of silence



HOW TO APPLY



Copy the template below into your message and fill it in. Applications

that do not use it will not be read — not because we are strict for

the sake of it, but because it is the only way we can compare people

fairly and answer everyone quickly.



Please write your answers yourself. We are not against AI, we use it

daily — but we can tell, and a generic answer tells us nothing about

you.



------- COPY FROM HERE -------



MONTOI



1. PORTFOLIO LINK:

   (required — Behance, Dribbble, Google Drive, personal site,

   anything we can open without a login)



2. THREE AMAZON IMAGES YOU DESIGNED YOURSELF:

   (links or attachments. Gallery images, infographics or A+ modules.

   If you worked in a team on any of them, say exactly what your part

   was.)



3. ONE OF THOSE THREE, RESIZED TO 300 PIXELS WIDE:

   (attach it. Yes, really — this is how our customers see it first.)



4. ONE PRODUCT VIDEO YOU EDITED:

   (link. 15-60 seconds is perfect.)



5. TAKE THE IMAGE FROM POINT 3. In your own words:

   What does the customer need to understand in the first two seconds,

   and what exactly in your design makes that happen?

   (3-5 sentences.)



6. YOUR SITUATION:

   - Expected monthly salary (USD):

   - Available from:

   - Do you currently have another full-time job or long-term client?

     (An honest yes is fine. A discovered no is not.)



7. ONE SENTENCE: what kind of design work do you actually enjoy?



------- COPY TO HERE -------



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We review applications as they come in and reply to everyone, yes or

no. If it looks like a fit, we invite you to a 20-minute video call

within a few days. If that goes well, we start with a paid trial

month at full salary, and then a long-term contract.



We are looking forward to seeing your work.



Sven Söllner

Goodcommerce GmbH

title: Podcast Video Editor | Riverside + Reels/Shorts
description:
Please read the full post before applying.



ABOUT THE PODCAST



Courageous Ones is a long-form personal development podcast hosted by Tenzin Lhoden. The show features honest conversations about courage, mindset, identity, entrepreneurship, and personal transformation.



I publish one 60–90+ minute episode each week.



THE ROLE



I am looking for one dependable podcast video editor for a long-term working relationship.



Episodes are recorded remotely through Riverside. Your job is to turn each recording into a clean full-length episode, a strong opening hook, and engaging short-form clips.



The editing style should feel professional, natural, and emotionally engaging. I do not want unnecessary effects or distracting transitions.



WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit one full podcast episode from Riverside

- Create a 30–75 second opening hook using the strongest highlights

- Add clean text to emphasize important lines

- Remove mistakes, repeated sections, technical problems, excessive pauses, and unnecessary filler

- Improve the pacing while preserving the natural conversation

- Clean, balance, and enhance the audio

- Apply basic color correction where needed

- Add the supplied intro, outro, logo, and guest information

- Find seven strong moments for short-form content

- Edit seven vertical clips under 60 seconds

- Add accurate, readable captions

- Format clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Keep project files and exports clearly organized

- Complete reasonable revisions after feedback



THE OPENING HOOK



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



The hook should use the most emotional, surprising, vulnerable, or thought-provoking moments from the episode. It should create curiosity without using misleading context or excessive effects.



I will provide examples showing the direction I want.



AI TOOLS ARE ENCOURAGED



I use AI in my own workflow and encourage you to use it too.



Riverside Magic Clips, Adobe Podcast, Opus Clip, Descript, Captions, ChatGPT, and similar tools are welcome.



AI should support your work. You remain responsible for checking context, caption accuracy, pacing, and final quality.



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience editing video podcasts, interviews, or talking-head content

- A portfolio showing long-form and short-form work

- Strong English comprehension

- Experience with Riverside recordings

- Experience with Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Desktop, or similar software

- Strong judgment around hooks, storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention

- Reliable internet and a computer suitable for editing large video files

- Clear communication and dependable weekly delivery

- Openness to feedback



Future episodes will also include in-person, multicamera recordings. Experience with this format is a bonus.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive a small paid editing test.



You will edit a short opening hook and one vertical clip from real podcast footage. This will help me evaluate your storytelling, pacing, captions, sound, and attention to detail.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



COURAGEOUS EDITOR



Please include:



1. A short introduction about your editing experience.

2. Links to two long-form podcast or interview edits.

3. Links to three Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts.

4. The editing and AI tools you use.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. Your normal turnaround time.

8. A short answer to this question:



What makes a podcast opening hook strong without making it feel misleading or over-edited?



Individual editors only. No agencies.



Applications without relevant examples or the words “COURAGEOUS EDITOR” will not be reviewed.

title: Forensic Accounting Assistant / Financial Transaction Analyst – Real Estate & Business Records
description:
I am seeking an experienced forensic accounting assistant or financial analyst to assist with organizing and analyzing financial records involving multiple business entities and real-estate transactions.



This project involves reviewing bank statements, accounting records, property transactions, construction expenses, loans, investor funds, and closing documents to create clear financial schedules and identify transactions requiring additional documentation or professional review.



Responsibilities include:



* Review and organize business and personal financial records.

* Enter and categorize transactions from bank statements into a master transaction ledger.

* Trace transfers between related businesses, individuals, and bank accounts.

* Identify large or unusual transfers and transactions requiring further documentation.

* Reconcile bank activity against accounting records, tax documents, loan records, invoices, and other supporting documentation.

* Create source-and-use-of-funds schedules.

* Reconstruct individual real-estate projects from property acquisition through construction and eventual sale.

* Track investor contributions, construction draws, contractor payments, developer fees, loan proceeds, closing proceeds, distributions, and profits.

* Create property-by-property profit/loss and cash-flow schedules.

* Identify transfers between related business entities.

* Identify personal expenditures that may have been paid from business accounts.

* Create schedules of transactions for which invoices, receipts, contracts, or other supporting documents are missing.

* Maintain an organized electronic document system linking transactions to their supporting records.

* Prepare Excel workbooks and summaries that can be reviewed by a U.S. attorney, CPA, or forensic accounting expert.



This position does NOT require the contractor to provide legal opinions, determine whether fraud or criminal activity occurred, contact opposing parties, or serve as an expert witness. The purpose is financial analysis, transaction tracing, reconciliation, and preparation of organized working papers for professional review.



Qualifications



Ideal candidate will have:



* Accounting, finance, audit, or bookkeeping background

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience reconciling bank statements

* Experience tracing transactions between multiple accounts

* Ability to analyze large amounts of financial data

* Strong attention to detail

* Experience with QuickBooks

* Experience with real-estate development/construction accounting strongly preferred

* Experience with forensic accounting, fraud examination, litigation support, or investigative accounting strongly preferred

* CPA/accounting degree or CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner) background is a plus

* Excellent written English

* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality

title: Pre-Claim Review Specialist (RN/LVN Preferred)
description:
We are a Medicare-certified home health agency seeking a dependable and detail-oriented individual with Medicare home health experience to prepare and manage Pre-Claim Review submissions through the PGBA portal. Ideally, an RN or LVN who can help with managing non-affirmations with clinical knowledge of Medical Necessity and Face-to-Face requirements for CMS.



This is a full-time remote position working U.S. Central Time hour from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Applicants must be comfortable consistently working this schedule.



The ideal candidate is a clinically knowledgeable person (preferably a nurse) who is highly organized, dependable, and comfortable following detailed processes. You should be able to work independently while knowing when to stop and escalate a concern.



Accuracy is extremely important in this role. We are looking for someone who will not simply upload and submit the documents provided. The right candidate will recognize when required documentation is missing, conflicting, or potentially insufficient and will promptly elevate the issue to the location before the submission is completed.



Primary Responsibilities

• Prepare Medicare Home Health Pre-Claim Review submissions through PGBA.

• Gather and organize all required documentation for each submission.

• Review clinical documentation for completeness before submission.

• Identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially insufficient documentation.

• Verify that required records are included, such as face-to-face documentation, orders, plans of care, certifications, OASIS assessments, and therapy documentation.

• Upload documents accurately and in the correct order.

• Submit Pre-Claim Review requests within established deadlines.

• Monitor the PGBA portal for decisions, requests, and status updates.

• Track submitted, affirmed, non-affirmed, pending, and resubmitted requests.

• Download and properly file decision letters and related documentation.

• Notify others promptly when documentation issues may delay submission or affect affirmation.

• Maintain accurate internal spreadsheets and tracking systems.

• Follow established workflows, checklists, and naming conventions.

• Protect all patient information and follow HIPAA and company confidentiality requirements.



Qualifications

• Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.

• Previous experience working with a Medicare-certified home health agency.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a dependable computer.

• Ability to work full-time during U.S. Central Time business hours.

• Experience reviewing clinical documentation, physician orders, plans of care, certifications, OASIS assessments, visit notes, and related medical records.

• Ability to recognize missing, conflicting, or potentially insufficient clinical documentation that is required for Pre-Claim Review.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

title: High-Level Shopify Website Designer & Developer for Music Artist
description:
I am a Christian hip-hop artist looking for an experienced Shopify website designer and developer to redesign and build my official artist website.



My current website is hosted on Shopify, and the new website must remain on Shopify. I need someone who understands both high-level creative design and Shopify development. This includes Shopify themes, Liquid, custom sections, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, animations, mobile optimization and merchandise functionality.



I am not looking for a basic website template with my photos and colors added to it. I want a modern, immersive and professional artist website that feels like its own creative world.



Artist Website References



Please review these websites to understand the quality and creative direction I am looking for:



Lecrae: 

KB: 

Ed Sheeran: 

Hozier: 

Hulvey: 

Miles Minnick: 

Kenny Mason: 

Genesis Owusu: 



These are references for the quality, storytelling, layouts, animations, atmosphere and overall experience I want. The final website should be completely original and should not directly copy any of these artists.



The creative direction should combine:



The professional structure and credibility of Lecrae and KB

The cinematic and personal storytelling of Ed Sheeran and Hozier

The modern Christian artist branding of Hulvey and Miles Minnick

The immersive creativity and world-building of Kenny Mason and Genesis Owusu



The website should clearly represent a Christian artist without looking like a generic church website, a basic Shopify store or a typical independent rapper website.



What the Website May Include

High-impact homepage

Latest music release

Music and streaming links

Music videos

Artist biography and testimony

Upcoming shows and events

Merchandise store

Photos and media

Booking and contact information

Press or EPK section

 and SMS fan capture

Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube and social media integrations

Google Analytics and Meta Pixel integration



The website must be fully responsive, fast-loading and easy to use across desktop, tablet and mobile.



I also need the website to be built in a way that allows me or my team to easily update music, videos, merchandise, tour dates, photos and announcements without requiring a developer for every small change.



Who I Am Looking For



I am looking for someone who:



Has strong experience designing and developing Shopify websites

Understands Shopify Online Store 2.0 and Liquid

Can create custom Shopify sections and animations

Has excellent visual taste and understands modern artist branding

Has experience with musicians, artists, entertainment, fashion, creators or personal brands

Uses modern tools and AI to work faster and more efficiently

Speaks and writes English clearly

Communicates consistently and follows deadlines

Can complete the project quickly without sacrificing quality

Can remain available for occasional paid website updates after launch



Using AI tools is encouraged for research, wireframing, coding, testing and efficient execution. However, I am not looking for a generic AI-generated website. The finished product must still feel original, intentional and professionally designed.



Project Structure



This is a fixed-price project, not a permanent hourly position.



I am looking for someone who can complete the website in approximately 7 to 14 days after receiving all necessary content and access. I do not want the project dragged out for several months.



After the initial website is finished, there may be ongoing paid work for new releases, merchandise drops, tour dates, landing pages and other updates.



How to Apply



Please send:



Three to five Shopify websites you personally designed or developed

Any websites you have built for musicians, artists, entertainment companies, creators, fashion brands or personal brands

A brief explanation of what you personally handled on each project

Your proposed fixed project price

Your estimated completion timeline

The number of revision rounds included

Your hourly or fixed rate for future updates

Any paid themes, Shopify apps or additional expenses you expect the project to require



Please only apply if you can provide live website examples that demonstrate the level of quality and creativity described above.

title: Short Form Video Editor for Music Artist
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for a highly creative Short Form Video Editor to work long term with an independent Christian hip hop artist.



This role is focused specifically on editing social media content.



You will not be responsible for managing social media accounts, answering comments, running ads, or handling marketing operations.



Your job is to take raw footage and turn it into fast paced, current, highly engaging short form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.



THE STYLE WE NEED



We are looking for someone who understands:



• Gen Z content



• Fast paced short form editing



• Retention focused editing



• Strong first second hooks



• Platform native TikTok and Instagram editing



• Music culture



• Hip hop culture



• Memes and internet culture



• Pattern interruptions



• Creative subtitles and text



• Sound effects



• Music synchronization



• Visual storytelling



• Organic looking edits



• High energy edits



• When to heavily edit a video and when to keep it simple



You should understand what content looks like right now, not what social media videos looked like three years ago.



We need edits that are built to compete for attention on modern social platforms.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



Our content library includes:



• Music videos



• Performance footage



• Studio footage



• Vlogs



• Behind the scenes content



• Interviews



• Lifestyle footage



• Gaming content



• Talking videos



• Long form videos



• Promotional music content



• Release content



You should be able to take longer footage and independently identify moments that can become strong short form videos.



We do not want to provide timestamps for every edit.



Part of your value should be recognizing what the content is.



CREATIVE REFERENCES



You should study content from artists such as:



• Miles Minnick



• Hulvey



• Lecrae



• Caleb Gordon



• Alex Jean



These are references for understanding the Christian hip hop market, culture, artist presentation, and content ecosystem.



However, we DO NOT want the content limited to Christian hip hop references.



You should also regularly study mainstream hip hop artists, creators, streamers, entertainment accounts, meme culture, TikTok trends, and other high performing social media content.



We want to take what is working across internet culture and creatively adapt it to a Christian hip hop artist without simply copying other people.



THIS IS NOT CORPORATE VIDEO EDITING



Please do not apply with a portfolio primarily consisting of:



• Real estate videos



• Restaurant content



• E commerce advertisements



• Corporate videos



• Basic podcast clips



• Talking head videos with automatic captions



• Generic business Reels



• Template based edits



Those examples do not help us evaluate whether you are right for this position.



We are specifically looking for music, artist, creator, entertainment, Gen Z, culture driven, or highly creative short form editing.



EXPERIENCE



Direct music industry experience is preferred but NOT required.



We care more about your creative ability than your resume.



If you are extremely talented at editing but have not had the opportunity to work with artists professionally yet, you are still encouraged to apply.



If your portfolio does not currently demonstrate this exact style but you believe you have the technical and creative ability to execute it, we may invite you to complete a paid test edit using our footage.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We want someone who:



• Has excellent creative instincts



• Understands current social media culture



• Watches Reels and TikTok enough to know what is actually trending



• Is strong in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, or similar software



• Can edit quickly without sacrificing quality



• Understands hooks and retention



• Can recognize good moments inside raw footage



• Can bring their own ideas to an edit



• Does not need every transition, sound effect, caption, or cut explained to them



• Takes feedback well



• Communicates consistently



• Meets deadlines



• Wants a long term position rather than a temporary editing project



This position will initially be approximately 10 to 15 hours per week, with the opportunity for more work as the relationship and artist continue to grow.



IMPORTANT QUALITY STANDARD



We are not hiring simply because we need more editing capacity.



We are hiring because we want to improve the quality of the content.



Our artist already has professionally edited social media and music content.



The person we hire needs to be capable of eventually producing content that is at least at our current level and ideally better.



If modern music artist content, Gen Z editing, TikTok culture, and creative short form videos are not your strengths, this will probably not be the right position for you.



HOW TO APPLY



Please create ONE Google Drive folder and send us the link.



Your folder should contain:



1. Your Best 3 to 5 Relevant Videos



Only include examples that represent the type of editing we are hiring for.



We would rather see three incredible edits than twenty average ones.



Please prioritize:



• Music content



• Artist content



• Creator content



• Gen Z content



• Entertainment content



• Fast paced short form videos



• Creative social media edits



Please DO NOT fill the folder with unrelated business or corporate work.



2. Short Introduction



Include a short document answering:



Why does this specific position interest you?



What type of content do you personally enjoy editing?



Which creators or artists do you currently think have some of the best short form content?



What editing software do you use?



How many hours per week are you currently available?



3. Portfolio



You may also include your full portfolio if you have one, but make sure the 3 to 5 relevant videos are easy for us to find first.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted applicants will receive additional information about the artist and current social media content.



At that stage, we will evaluate whether your creative style fits what we are building.



Some applicants may also be invited to complete a paid test edit.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry, current, dependable, and interested in building with us long term.

title: Shopify Admin Assistant (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We're a performance marketing agency running paid media and CRO for about 10 DTC ecommerce brands. Our clients run their own stores day to day. We need someone to handle the Shopify changes our work requires — bulk edits, template rollouts, A/B test setup, shipping and promo changes — across those client stores.



This is project-based work, not daily store management.



What you'd do:



- Shipping: edit rates, add and configure shipping zones and regions, set up Shopify Markets

- Bulk product edits: filter products by collection, type or tag, then apply templates or update fields in the bulk editor

- Theme editor: duplicate the theme before any change, add and arrange sections and blocks, paste in code we give you, publish once approved

- Launch A/B tests in ABConvert, Intelligems or Elevate, and check both variants work on desktop and mobile before traffic goes live

- Set up and end promos on schedule: discount codes, automatic discounts, announcement bars

- General admin: collections, metafields, navigation, URL redirects, app settings

- Run test purchases to confirm tracking events are firing, screenshot the result, and tell us if they aren't

- Export data from Shopify analytics when we need it for reporting

- Keep a simple log of what you changed on each client store



What this role is not:



You won't be building or fixing tracking, troubleshooting product feeds, writing copy, or designing pages. We have people for that.



What we need from you:



- You've worked across multiple Shopify stores, not just one — agency, freelance or brand-side is all fine

- Comfortable in the theme editor on Online Store 2.0 themes, especially Dawn-based ones

- Basic HTML/CSS. You don't need to be a developer, but you should be able to paste a code block where we tell you without breaking the page

- You follow a checklist exactly, and when something isn't on the checklist you ask instead of guessing

- You never make changes to a live store without confirming first

- Clear written English, some overlap with US business hours



Details:



- Remote, ongoing

- $6-$12/hr, paid on the 1st and the 15th

- We cover the bank transfer fees

- You'll work across several client stores through our agency partner account



How to apply:



Send:

1. Which Shopify stores you've worked on and what you did on them

2. Your answer to this: a client has 200+ products and wants a new product template applied to everything in one collection. How would you do it?

3. Your hourly rate and weekly availability

BNDK Digital is a performance marketing agency for DTC & ecommerce brands — Meta + Google ads, creative strategy, CRO. Our whole mission is killing the "we got burnt by an agency before" story that every brand owner tells.



Creative is the thing that d
 whether an account scales or stalls. As our Creative Strategist, you own that. Your concepts are what let us push more budget into an account without the numbers falling apart. That's the whole job.

???? THE DETAILS:

- Send us 3x ad creatives you've created that crushed, plus what you learned from the earlier versions that got you to the winning one.

title: AI Video Editor — Meta Ads
description:
AI Video Editor — Meta Ads



Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $500 – $1000 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus every time one of your videos becomes a winner we scale.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your reel — we will not review an application without work to watch.



What the job is



We run supplement brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Our best-performing ads are AI-generated video: VSLs built from a script, carried by B-roll we generate ourselves.



We have the scripts. We have the system. We need the person who turns a script into a finished Meta ad, every day, using Higgsfield and Google Flow.



Your work



1. Turn the script into a finished VSL.

You get a written script — hook, problem, mechanism, offer. You produce the video that delivers it: generated scenes, voiceover, cuts, captions, sound. Finished ad, ready to upload.



2. Generate the B-roll that carries each beat.

The script says "most people take three supplements a day" — you produce the shot that shows it. You write the prompts in Higgsfield and Google Flow, you generate, and you keep the look consistent from scene to scene: same lighting, same product, same world.



3. Regenerate until it matches.

The first output is never the one. You see what is off — the hands, the label, the timing, the lighting — you fix the prompt and go again. This is most of the craft.



4. Cut it for Meta.

The first three seconds d
 everything. You feel it when a cut lands one beat too slow. Correct dimensions, correct length, caption style, naming convention — every time, no interpretation.



5. Deliver a batch every day, and apply the notes.

You send the day's videos for review, you get revision notes back, you apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log everything.

Every video archived with a unique name and the prompts that made it. We must be able to re-cut or rebuild any winner months later without starting from scratch.



What we need from you

You have made AI video before, with Higgsfield or Google Flow. Kling, Veo or Runway also count. You already know the first generation is rarely usable.

You can edit properly. CapCut, Premiere or After Effects — pacing, captions, sound design, clean exports.

You understand what makes an ad hold attention. A VSL is not a montage. It builds.

You follow the format exactly. Dimensions, length, captions, naming. Not open to interpretation.

Written English good enough to work from our scripts and answer our revision notes.

Extremely organised. Files, versions, prompts, archives.

You deliver every single day. This is volume with a rhythm, not one masterpiece a month.

Nice to have



ElevenLabs or any voice cloning. UGC-style ads. Direct response video — VSLs, advertorials.
 Ads Manager. Supplement or health brands.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

The scripts and the system already exist. You are not inventing the strategy, you are executing it well and fast.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid trial first: one script, one finished VSL — generated B-roll, voiceover, captions, sound, Meta-ready. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.



Again: the only way to apply is
