title: AI Video Producer & Editor - UGC, VSL & Animation Ads
description:
AI VIDEO PRODUCER & EDITOR - UGC, VSL & ANIMATION ADS

Remote | Project based, paid per batch | Start: ASAP | $40 - $110 per batch





READ THIS FIRST



This job post is long. That is on purpose.



I am hiring ONE person. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 lazy ones. If you send the same message to 40 job posts a day, close this now - you will not get through.



But please do not be scared off either. You will not be inventing anything. You get the script, the reference ad, the format specs and every tool paid for. What you need is to already be good at this, and to deliver on time.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





ABOUT US



We run five direct-response e-commerce brands on Shopify. We sell physical products to customers in the United States, and we advertise on
 and Instagram at a four-figure daily budget.



Every single ad we run is produced with AI. No film crew, no studio, no actors. That is the whole model.





THE BIG IDEA - WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS MORE THAN A NORMAL EDITING JOB



Right now our creative output is the bottleneck. Not the budget, not the products, not the audience - the number of finished ads we can put in front of people.



That is a strange and very specific problem to have: we can fund more ad spend than we can produce ads for. Every week we do not ship enough new creatives is a week we leave money on the table, because in paid advertising creatives burn out. An ad that prints money today is tired in three weeks, and if there is nothing new to replace it, the whole account cools down.



So the number of ads you deliver is not a production statistic. It is the ceiling on how big this business can get. That is the job.



Concretely: we want to go from a handful of finished ads per week to 15-20 finished ads per week within your first 60 days, without the quality dropping.



This is a doer role, not a manager role. You produce. Nobody reports to you and you do not build a team. If that changes later, it changes because you made it obvious that it should.





WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE



You must be able to produce all of these yourself:



- AI UGC ads - a generated person on camera showing and talking about a product

- VSL edits - longer sales videos cut to a script we give you

- AI voiceover - written, generated and timed to the cut

- Cartoon and claymation ads - stylized animation, not photoreal

- 1:1 ad iterations - this one matters most, see below

- The cut itself - captions burned in, clean sans-serif, inside the safe zone, hook in the first two seconds, no dead air, exported to spec



Strongly preferred on top of that: Suno-style music ads where a song carries the ad, talking-head avatar ads, and Disney-style animation.



About the 1:1 iterations, because this is the majority of the work and it is where people drop out: we hand you an ad that already works and you rebuild it exactly, changing one variable. Same structure, same pacing, same feel, different hook or different actor. If the reference has a cut on beat four, your version has a cut on beat four. "Close enough" is not a delivery. If you need creative freedom to stay motivated, you will not enjoy this role - and we would both rather find that out now.





WHAT A BATCH IS



We work in batches, not in hours.



BATCH A - Cut only. Ten finished ads from clips and product footage we send you. 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.



BATCH B - Full production. Three to five finished ads, generated and cut by you from a script. Usually one concept with hook variations.



Right now we run 3-4 batches per week. That number grows as we scale, and we want the person who grows with it.



Turnaround: a batch is delivered within 48 hours of receiving the brief and the assets.





STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Start your message with the word ORANGE, exactly like this:



ORANGE - Your Full Name



Apply right here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 us - we read everything in this system and nowhere else. If ORANGE is not the first thing in your message we will never see it, no matter how good your portfolio is. This is not a joke and there is no exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.





ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part we care about most, so we are going to be very clear.



We are not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. We have zero problem with any of that.



What we have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if a render fails and the batch will be late - send us one message. Before the deadline, not after it. That is all we ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Going quiet on a batch is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because we are strict, but because we plan ad launches around your delivery date and we cannot plan around someone we have to chase.



Beyond that, we expect three things:



- You can already do this. We give you the tools, the budget, the script and the specs. We do not teach you the craft. If you are hoping to learn AI video generation on this job, this is the wrong job and we will both waste our time.

- You ask before you produce. When a brief is unclear you ask first, instead of delivering five wrong ads and then explaining them.

- You flag what will not work. If a script cannot be built visually, tell us before you start, not after the render.





THE TOP THREE SKILLS WE ARE HIRING FOR



1. AI video generation - you already produce photoreal or stylized AI footage today, in production, not as an experiment

2. Short-form direct-response editing - you understand pacing, hooks, and why an ad dies in second three

3. Speed with consistency - you deliver on schedule, and batch number twelve looks like batch number one





WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements)



1. 2+ years producing or editing short-form video, at least the last year with AI-generated footage.



2. You have shipped AI video in production - for clients, for a brand, or for your own offers. Not tutorials, not test renders. We want to see the actual ads.



3. CapCut or Premiere Pro for the cut, your pick, as long as the output is consistent.



4. Hands-on with at least one serious AI generation stack, and the judgment to know when a generation is unusable and needs to be redone instead of shipped.



5. You work in OUR generation stack, and that stack is built on Polaris. Read the tools section below before you apply - this is the one thing about our setup that is not up for discussion, and we would rather you know it now than on day one.



6. Conversational English, spoken and written.



7. Reliable internet, a machine that can handle the work, and the ability to hit a 48-hour turnaround.



8. Willing to sign a freelance contract and a short NDA before you get access to our assets.





BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of the list)



- You have already worked in Polaris, or in a comparable AI ad studio, and can tell us what it is good at and where it falls apart

- You have produced paid ads before, not just organic content

- After Effects

- ElevenLabs or comparable voice tools

- You have built your own generation workflow and can explain why it is faster than the obvious one

- Music-driven ads, avatar ads, Disney-style animation





THE TOOLS WE USE



We pay for everything, including every single generation. You never pay for a credit or a subscription.



POLARIS IS THE CORE OF OUR STACK, AND WORKING IN IT IS PART OF THE JOB.



Polaris (
) is an AI ad studio built specifically for e-commerce: you give it a product URL or a product image and it produces UGC-style video and image ads. It generates the footage, it generates the AI actors, it writes the captions, and its ad cloner rebuilds an existing winning ad with one variable changed. That last part is exactly the 1:1 iteration work described above, which is the majority of what you will do here - which is why we picked it.



We have tested the alternatives. Polaris is faster and cheaper per finished ad than anything else we ran, and that difference is the whole reason this role exists at the volume it does. So this is not a preference we will negotiate away: if you come on board, you produce in Polaris.



You do NOT need previous Polaris experience. We do not expect anyone to have used it for years - it is new. We pay for the account, and if you already know your way around any modern AI generation tool, you will be productive in it within a day or two. What we do need is that you are genuinely willing to move into our stack instead of insisting on the workflow you already have. If that is a dealbreaker for you, this is the wrong role and we would both rather find out before the call.



Around Polaris we also work with Magnific and Higgsfield for generation, ElevenLabs for voice, and CapCut for the cut. Those we are flexible on: if you have a faster way to get to the same output, bring it and we will look at it together on the call. Polaris is the fixed point, the rest is open.



Communication runs on
 and
. Files live in a shared asset library with a fixed folder structure and naming convention.





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Every tool account and every generation, fully paid - Polaris included. You never spend your own money on this job.

- The script for every ad - you never write copy

- Format specs and reference ads, so "done" is never a guess

- A proper shared asset library. You will not be hunting for files.

- One revision round per batch, with specific feedback, not vague feedback

- Direct access to the person making the decisions. No account manager, no layers.





WORKING STYLE AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- Fully remote. We do not care where you sit.

- The work itself is asynchronous. No shift, no fixed working hours, no being on call. You get a brief, you deliver a batch within 48 hours, and how you organize your day is your business.

- No overlap with our time zone required for the work. We are in Europe and Asia; you will not be asked to work nights.

- One fixed 30-minute call per week, camera on. We agree on the day and time together once you start, and then it stays there. That is where we go through what landed and what did not, where the revisions keep coming from, what you need from us, and what we want produced next. You get direct feedback and we expect you to use it. We also expect you to tell us when a brief is bad or a spec makes no sense - that call goes both ways.

- This is high tempo. We are a small operation scaling paid ads aggressively, priorities move, and a batch that was due Friday is due Friday. If you need a slow, predictable environment, this is not it.

- Where this is going: volume grows as we scale. More batches per week, higher rates, and first pick of the work. Long-term is the point - we are not looking for a one-off gig, we want one person who gets faster every month.





HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



Five numbers, nothing else:



1. Batches delivered per week

2. Turnaround time per batch - target: under 48 hours

3. Revision rounds per batch - target: one or fewer

4. Spec compliance - correct format, safe zone, naming, folder

5. Iteration accuracy - does your 1:1 rebuild actually match the reference



We do not measure hours. We do not measure how hard something was.





COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



You are paid per delivered batch. Not per hour, not per month. We start low and we go up fast, and we are honest about that instead of promising you a number we do not know you are worth yet.



STARTING RATE - your first batches:

Batch A (10 finished cuts): $40

Batch B (3-5 full productions): $70



AFTER 4 ACCEPTED BATCHES, delivered on time and to spec:

Batch A: $60

Batch B: $110



We review again after that. If you are fast and consistent, the rate keeps moving up. This is not a carrot we dangle - it is how we pay everyone who works with us long-term.

Why we start low: we have been burned by portfolios that did not match the actual output. Four batches is enough for both of us to know whether this works. If you are as good as your portfolio says, you are at the higher rate within two weeks.





ENGLISH



Your portfolio tells us nothing about your English - the voice on those ads was generated. So we ask separately.



Two steps, and we are open about both. First, the short recording you send with your application: that is how we hear you before anyone spends time on a call. Written English alone is not enough. We have been burned by exactly this before and we are not doing it again.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with ORANGE - Your Full Name.



Keep it short. We are not asking you to do unpaid work to apply - nothing below takes more than ten minutes, and nothing below is work you have to invent for us. Be specific: vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. YOUR WORK. Links to 2-3 AI videos or ads YOU made. Own work only - no agency reels, no team projects, no "I was part of the team that". For each one, tell us which tools you used and what your part was.



2. YOUR SETUP AND YOUR SPEED. Which tools do you work in, and roughly how many finished 15-second ads can you produce in a working day? A real number, not "many".



3. POLARIS. One or two sentences, nothing more. Have you used Polaris (
) before - yes or no? Either answer is fine, we are not filtering on it. What we want to know is whether you are willing to produce in it as your main tool, because that is how this role works. If you have used it, tell us what you built with it.



4. WHAT YOU WANT TO EARN per batch, for Batch A and for Batch B.



5. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message, an unlisted YouTube link, whatever is easiest. Introduce yourself and walk us through one of the videos you linked above: what you made, which tools, what was hard about it. No production, no script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine, and we mean that. This is the one thing you send us that is not supposed to look produced. We are not judging your setup or your confidence on camera. We want to hear how you speak English, because that d
 whether this works. Send it as a separate link from your portfolio links so we do not mix them up.



That is it. No cover letter, no essay, no test task. If your work looks right and we can understand each other, we talk.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We look at your work and listen to your recording

2. Short video call in English, camera on

3. After the call: a small PAID test batch on a real brief, produced in Polaris. We set up your account and walk you through it first - the test measures whether you can hit a spec, not whether you can guess your way around a new interface.

The test comes after we have spoken, not before. You get paid for it whether or not we hire you. We keep the number of tests small on purpose, so if you get there you are already a serious candidate.



Applications that do not start correctly, or that skip any of the 5 points, will not be reviewed. We are strict about this on purpose: following a brief exactly is the single most important part of this job.

title: Amazon Catalog Specialist
description:
Amazon Catalog & PPC Specialist

Listings, FBA Logistics, PPC

Employment Type: Remote, Full-Time    |    Reports To: Ecommerce Operations Manager



About the Role

We're a growing multi-marketplace ecommerce business (Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, eBay) selling novelty apparel, drinkware, custom gift sets, and seasonal/occasion-driven products. We're looking for a hands-on Amazon specialist who can independently manage listing optimization, FBA inventory planning, and PPC campaigns — someone who understands the mechanics behind the numbers, not just how to follow a checklist.



This is not an entry-level data-entry role. You'll be trusted with live pricing, inventory decisions with real financial consequences, and campaign budgets. Accuracy and accountability matter more than speed.



Core Responsibilities



Listing Creation & SEO Optimization

• Create new Amazon listings from scratch and optimize existing ones (titles, bullets, backend search terms) following A9 algorithm best practices

• Conduct keyword research using tools like Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet) and prioritize by conversion signal, not just raw search volume

• Maintain listing compliance with Amazon content policies, character limits, and trademark restrictions

• Optimize existing listings based on performance data and seasonal relevance

• Add and manage listing videos and enhanced content to improve conversion

• Communicate clearly and proactively — flag issues, scope changes, and confirm before acting on anything with broad or irreversible impact



FBA Inventory & Shipment Management

• Project FBA order quantities based on sales velocity, sell-through rate, and upcoming seasonal demand

• Build and upload FBA shipment plans, including flat file creation and upload

• Monitor inventory health metrics (IPI score, days of supply, excess/aged inventory) and take corrective action before problems compound

• Understand and correctly manage the distinction between FBA and FBM (merchant-fulfilled) listings — including the operational and financial implications of converting between the two

• Flag stockout or overstock risk ahead of key seasonal windows



Flat File & Catalog Management

• Confidently build, edit, and upload Amazon flat files (Price & Quantity, Inventory, Listings templates) without introducing catalog-wide errors

• Understand the difference between List Price and Sale Price fields, including Sale Start/End Date behavior, before making bulk pricing changes

• Double-check bulk changes against a defined SKU list before uploading — no catalog-wide edits without explicit scope confirmation

• Troubleshoot and resolve flat file upload errors



PPC Campaign Management

• Create and optimize Sponsored Products campaigns (auto/manual, exact/phrase/broad match structures)

• Analyze PPC reports to identify underperforming keywords, budget drains, and scaling opportunities

• Manage bids with attention to ACOS, CTR, and conversion efficiency — not spend alone

• Tie PPC strategy to seasonal demand windows and product launch timing



Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central (not just Vendor Central or general "Amazon experience")

• Proven experience with Amazon flat file editing and bulk uploads

• Working knowledge of FBA logistics: shipment creation, inventory planning, IPI score factors

• Clear understanding of FBA vs. FBM operational differences and when/how to convert between them

• Experience running and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns with real budget accountability

• Familiarity with keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar)

• High attention to detail — this role directly affects live pricing and inventory with real financial impact

• Comfortable asking clarifying questions before making bulk or irreversible changes, rather than guessing

• Strong written communicator — able to clearly explain issues, scope, and status without back-and-forth



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience across multiple marketplaces (Etsy, Walmart, eBay)

• Experience with novelty, gift, or seasonal/occasion-driven product categories

• Familiarity with Amazon compliance issues (trademark, IP, safety violations) and how to resolve them



Put ORANGE on the "SUBJECT TITLE" for keywords



What Success Looks Like in This Role

• Bulk pricing or catalog changes are scoped, confirmed, and verified before and after upload — no unintended catalog-wide impact

• FBA shipments are timed and sized correctly against seasonal demand, with no avoidable stockouts or excess inventory

• PPC spend is monitored proactively, with issues (like bid-floor errors or underperformers) caught early, not after significant spend

• Listings are optimized based on real keyword and conversion data, not guesswork

description:
We are looking for a skilled **FlutterFlow + Supabase App Developer** to help build a new customer referral and rewards mobile app called **Royal Rewards** for Royal Financial Consulting.

### About the App



Royal Rewards will allow our customers to create an account, receive their own referral code/link, refer new customers, earn points, earn cash referral bonuses, redeem rewards, and track everything from their personal dashboard.



For example:



**Refer a customer → Earn Points → Customer completes an eligible tax return → Earn $50 Cash**



We will also offer milestone bonuses, rewards, promotions, giveaways, and special influencer/ambassador referral codes.



### Main Features

* Customer signup/login

* User profiles

* Unique referral codes and links

* Referral tracking

* Referral status system

* Cash transaction history

* Points cash-out requests

* Rewards marketplace

* Reward redemption

* Giveaways/promotions

* Influencer/Ambassador promo codes

* Push notifications

* Admin dashboard

* Analytics/reporting



The **Admin Dashboard** must allow us to manage customers, referrals, points, cash rewards, cash-out requests, referral statuses, rewards, promo codes, influencers, and promotions.

**FlutterFlow**

**Supabase**

**PostgreSQL/databases**

**Row Level Security (RLS)**

**iOS/Android deployment**

Security and database structure are very important.



Users must only be able to access their own information. Customers should NOT be able to manually change their points, cash balance, referral status, or account role.

title: Experienced Social Media Content Designer & Video Editor for Christian Book Brand
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re looking for an experienced Social Media Designer and Video Editor to create content for Biblical Teachings, an established Christian publishing brand.



Instagram: 



Our Instagram presence is still in its early stages, so you’ll have the opportunity to help establish its creative direction rather than simply follow an existing content system.



We want the brand to feel modern, warm, uplifting and recognisably Christian without looking dated, overly corporate or like generic religious content.



We’re looking for someone with excellent visual judgement who can take our books, ideas and brand assets and turn them into content people genuinely want to stop and engage with.



WHAT YOU’LL CREATE



Your work may include:



- Instagram carousels and static posts

- Short-form videos and Reels

- AI-assisted UGC-style and book-related videos

- Devotional and faith-based content

- Book spotlights, promotions and reader testimonials

- Early Reader Team recruitment content

- Reel covers, Stories and reusable Canva templates

- Creative assets that may also be used in advertising

- Book mockups using our existing systems, with the ability to create new ones when required



Some projects may include editing founder-led talking-head footage. This could involve selecting the strongest sections, removing pauses, improving pacing, adding captions and supporting visuals, and formatting the finished video for Instagram.



This is a creative production role. You will not be responsible for managing our Meta advertising campaigns.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



- Have a strong portfolio of social media design and short-form content

- Have excellent visual taste and a clear understanding of typography, layout, colour and spacing

- Be highly proficient in Canva

- Be able to create engaging carousels rather than simply placing text onto generic templates

- Have experience editing short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok or similar platforms

- Have excellent written English and close attention to detail

- Be able to follow a brief while contributing your own ideas

- Communicate reliably and respond well to feedback

- Provide organised, fully editable source files

- Understand brand consistency, copyright and commercial asset usage



CHRISTIAN UNDERSTANDING



You must have a strong understanding of Christianity, Scripture and the Christian audience. Being a practising Christian is strongly preferred.



Our content needs to feel authentic and appropriate for Christian readers, so please tell us about your connection to the Christian faith or your experience creating Christian content.



AI AND CREATIVE TOOLS



AI-assisted short-form content is likely to become an important part of this role. You don’t need to be an expert in every platform, but you should be comfortable learning and using the tools and workflows we provide.



We may provide access to Canva Pro, Descript and selected AI content-creation platforms, along with scripts, book covers, mockup templates, brand assets and creative references.



We value AI as a tool, but we are not looking for someone who relies on it to produce generic content without thoughtful editing or creative judgement.



PAY AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT



Pay will start at $5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience and portfolio quality.



This role will begin with a small paid trial project. The trial is not a guarantee of ongoing work, but there is potential for regular part-time work if we’re a good fit.



We expect the workload to begin flexibly and potentially grow to around 15-20 hours per week. We may use an hourly or pay-per-batch arrangement depending on the type of work.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1) A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

2) A link to your portfolio, including examples of Instagram carousels, static posts and short-form videos. Please clearly identify which pieces you personally created.

3) A brief explanation of your connection to Christianity or your experience creating content for Christian audiences.

4) Three types of Instagram content you believe could work well for Biblical Teachings. Briefly describe how each would look and why it would appeal to our audience.

5) Links to two Instagram accounts or posts whose visual direction you believe could inspire Biblical Teachings. Briefly explain which is your favourite and why.

6) Details of your experience with Canva, short-form video editing and AI creative tools.

7) Your availability, expected hourly rate and how many hours you could offer each week.



Please attach an image of banana pancakes to your application.



Applications that do not include the requested information will not be considered.



We look forward to seeing your work and welcoming you to the family!

title: Influencer & Affiliate Manager
description:
To be considered apply at the bottom of the job description.



Remote, full-time. Anywhere.



We make football gear — shin pads, grip socks and performance kit — and we sell it worldwide. Over 200,000 people follow us across Instagram and TikTok.



We are building an army of affiliates and creators: hundreds of young footballers filming, posting, and earning from what they sell. Everything for it is already built and nobody has used any of it yet. This is the person who starts it.



The role



You are the main point of contact for every creator and affiliate we work with.



That means outbound — finding young footballers on Instagram and TikTok and reaching out, every day. It means inbound, handling everyone who comes to us. It means getting people signed up, with their product, their link and their code sorted. And it means running our 
 and keeping it somewhere people actually want to be.



The hardest part, and the part the job is really judged on, is keeping people producing. Anyone can sign someone up. A roster that posts for six weeks and goes quiet is a failed programme. So you are watching what comes in, replying to every single clip within 72 hours by name, and knowing who has gone quiet before they have properly gone.



You will also spot the people whose content is working and put them forward to move up. Affiliates earn commission on what they sell. The ones whose footage performs get put on a contract and earn from the ad spend behind it. That ladder is the whole pitch, and you are the one who walks people up it.



What this role is not



It is not a marketing strategy job. The system is designed and built — 
, tracking, sign-up pages, the payout side. You are not being hired to redesign it, you are being hired to run it and grow it. If your instinct on day one is to rebuild the programme rather than fill it, this is the wrong role for you.



Who I am looking for



Someone who genuinely loves football. You will watch several hundred clips a month from teenagers on pitches, and you have to be able to tell a good one from a nice one. That judgement cannot be taught quickly and it is the thing most candidates will not have.



Someone who is ruthless with an inbox. Hundreds of messages, nobody ignored, nothing templated. If you write like a brand rather than a person, creators stop replying and the whole thing dies quietly.



Someone who has run a community before — a 
, a group chat, a roster, anything where people showed up because of you specifically. I care far more about that than about where you have worked.



And someone careful. This role touches what people get paid. A sloppy tag or a wrong name in a spreadsheet means somebody's money is wrong, and that is how you lose trust with a roster you spent months building.



Strong written English matters more here than anywhere else in the company, because almost the entire job is short written messages to strangers.

# Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer | Work From Home | PHP 85.99/hour



We are looking for a **Print Ad Designer / Graphic Designer** to join our growing team in a **100% work-from-home position**.



In this role, you will create print advertisements for newspapers and other publications using a specialized proprietary design platform. The platform is designed to make the ad creation process simple and efficient, and we will provide complete training on the software, workflow, and quality standards.



You do not need years of professional design experience, but you **must have some previous design experience and a good eye for design**. You should understand what makes an advertisement look clean, professional, balanced, and visually appealing.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Creating newspaper and print advertisements using our client's proprietary design platform

* Designing ads based on provided content, instructions, templates, and branding

* Arranging text, images, colors, fonts, and other design elements

* Making sure advertisements are visually clean, balanced, and professional

* Reviewing completed ads for spelling, formatting, alignment, spacing, and design issues

* Producing multiple advertisements throughout the workday while maintaining consistent quality

* Making revisions when necessary based on feedback

* Communicating and working closely with our trainers and other members of the design team



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has previous graphic design or other relevant design experience

* Has a strong eye for layout and visual presentation

* Understands basic design principles such as typography, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, color, and composition

* Has experience with Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design software

* Has strong attention to detail

* Has good written and verbal English communication skills

* Is comfortable learning new software and systems

* Can follow instructions and established processes

* Is reliable, organized, and able to work effectively as part of a remote team

* Has a reliable computer and internet connection



You do **not** need to be an advanced graphic designer. We are looking for someone with a good design foundation and visual judgment who can learn our system and consistently produce quality work.



## Full Training Provided



We provide complete training for this position.



We have our own training system and dedicated trainers who will teach you how to use the design platform, understand the workflow, and create advertisements that meet our quality standards.



Previous experience with this specific platform is **not required**.



## Compensation & Work Setup



**Starting salary: PHP 85.99/hour**



This is a **fully remote, 100% work-from-home position**.



There will be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities for team members who perform well and grow with the company.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your resume

* A short introduction about yourself

* A brief description of your previous print design or relevant design experience

* A portfolio or examples of previous design work, if available



A formal portfolio is not required, but we would like to see examples of your previous design work if you have them.



We're looking for reliable people with a strong eye for design who are eager to learn, communicate well, and work as part of a growing team.

title: Customer Support VA - Shopify E-Commerce, AI-Assisted
description:
US MARKET
 SUPPORT VA - SHOPIFY E-COMMERCE, AI-ASSISTED

Remote | Part-time, about 2-3 hours per day (growing) | Start: ASAP | $2.50 - $4 per hour





READ THIS FIRST



This job post is long. That is on purpose.



I am hiring ONE person. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 lazy ones. If you send the same message to 40 job posts a day, close this now - you will not get through.



But please do not be scared off either. You will not be thrown into deep water alone. We have written SOPs for every situation, training videos of real past cases, I will train you, and we have a 1-on-1 call every single week. You do not need to invent anything. You need to be reliable, careful, and willing to learn our system.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





ABOUT US



We run five direct-response e-commerce brands on Shopify. We sell physical products to customers in the United States, and we advertise on
 and Instagram at a four-figure daily budget.



Growth means more orders, and more orders mean more customer
s. That inbox is what we are hiring for.





THE BIG IDEA - WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS MORE THAN A NORMAL SUPPORT JOB



Acquiring a customer through paid ads is expensive. We pay for every single one before we ever make a cent.



Now think about what happens when one of them writes to us and gets no answer for four days. They do not politely ask again. They open a PayPal dispute or they call their bank and do a chargeback. And that does not just cost us the order - it costs us the dispute fee, it costs us the product that is already on a plane, and if enough of them pile up it costs us the payment processor itself. A store that loses its payment provider is a store that is dead, no matter how good the ads are.



That is the real math of this job. Every
 you answer fast and properly is a dispute that never happens. You are not "answering tickets" - you are protecting the money at the exact point where it leaks out.



A business is also like a house. Most people only build the front: the ads, the product page, the pretty pictures. Then the first storm comes and it falls over, because there is no foundation. The foundation is the backend. That is what you are.





THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You own the customer inbox across all five brands and you keep it at zero.



This is not a typing job. You do not write every reply from scratch. We use AI to draft, and your job is to judge the draft, fix what reads robotic, check the facts in Shopify, and send. Editor and decision-maker, not typist.



The number we hold you to: every customer
 gets an answer within 24 hours. That is the whole scoreboard. Within 90 days we want you handling 80 percent of the inbox without asking us anything.



This is a doer role. Nobody reports to you and you do not build a team.





HOW THE DAY WORKS



One focused block per day. You come in, you clear the inbox across all brands, you handle what you can handle, you flag what needs us, you send a short end-of-day note. Then you are done.



Our customers are in the United States, so the inbox fills up overnight your time. You work your block in the morning, Philippine time, and everything that came in during the US evening is handled before it gets old.



We are looking for one person long-term. Someone who gets faster and more independent every month, not someone who needs the same question answered twice.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. CUSTOMER
S (your main job)



We currently handle around [MAIL-VOLUMEN] customer
s per week across all five brands.



- Sweep the support inboxes across all five brands and clear them, every working day

- Answer tracking questions ("where is my order") using our tracking tools and the order data in Shopify

- Answer product and usage questions from our templates

- Process returns, cancellations and address changes along our decision tree

- Keep the inbox at zero. No
 older than 24 hours.



2. CASES AND DISPUTES



- Spot disputes early - PayPal cases, Klarna claims, chargebacks - and log every single one in our tracker with its deadline

- Respond to the case: upload the tracking, assemble the evidence, write the response

- Never let a deadline pass. A dispute we lose by default is money we simply hand over.



3. ADDRESS PROBLEMS



- When an address is wrong, incomplete or undeliverable, you take it from there: you
 the customer, you get the correct address, you update it in Shopify, and you confirm it back to our supplier.

- We should not have to sit in the middle of that. You are the link.



4. PUSHING PROBLEMS BACK TO THE SOURCE (this one matters to us)



You do not just fix problems for the customer. You push them back up the chain so they stop happening.



If ten customers this week asked the same question, that is not ten tickets. That is one broken product page, and we want to know about it. If three packages arrived damaged, we do not want you to quietly send three replacements and move on - we want the order numbers, the photos, and the question of why it keeps happening.



So you document it: what went wrong, how often, which orders. Then you bring it to the weekly call and we fix the cause instead of the symptom.



Tell us when one of our templates, our processes or our product pages is bad. We built them and we will change them. Nobody here is attached to being right.



To be clear about what this job is NOT: you do not order stock, you do not manage inventory, you do not do purchasing, you do not write marketing copy, and you never talk to a customer on the phone. Everything is written and asynchronous.





STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Start your message with the word TAMARIND, exactly like this:



TAMARIND - Your Full Name



Apply right here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 us - we read everything in this system and nowhere else. If TAMARIND is not the first thing in your message we will never see it, no matter how good your experience is. This is not a joke and there is no exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.





ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part we care about most, so we are going to be very clear.



We are not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. We have zero problem with any of that.



What we have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if something happens in your family, if you simply cannot work today - send us one message. Before, not after. That is all we ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Disappearing without a word is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because we are strict about hours, but because we cannot run a business on someone we have to chase.



Beyond that, we expect three things:



- You work independently. You do not need to be reminded or micromanaged.

- You own the outcome. An escalation comes to us with your recommendation attached, not as a forwarded
 that says "what should I do".

- You are honest when you do not know. A wrong answer sent confidently to a customer costs us a dispute. "I need to check this" costs us nothing.





THE TOP THREE SKILLS WE ARE HIRING FOR



1. Shopify Admin, hands-on - orders, customers, fulfillments, refunds, every day

2. Native-level written English - our customers are American, and a reply that sounds translated costs us the sale

3. Judgment on AI drafts - you know when a draft is confidently wrong, and you check before you send





WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements)



1. Hands-on Shopify Admin experience: orders, customers, fulfillments, refunds. Not "I have seen Shopify" - you have worked in it daily and you can tell us exactly what you did in there.



2. Written English that reads like a native-level support agent wrote it. Our customers are American and they notice.



3. A paid ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro subscription, and you already use it daily. Not the free tier. This role runs on AI drafting and the free versions are too slow and too limited for a daily inbox block. If you do not have one yet but you are otherwise a fit, say so - we will cover it from day one. What we cannot work with is someone who has never used these tools seriously.



4. You know where AI gets things wrong. You can tell when a draft is confidently wrong and you check the facts in Shopify before you send.



5. Parcel tracking tools (17track or similar) and the patience to read what a scan history actually means.



6. Google Sheets for the dispute tracker.



7. Reliable daily availability, a stable internet connection, a working computer, and you are reachable on
 during your working block.



8. At least 1 year in customer support, e-commerce preferred.



9. Willing to sign a freelance contract and a short NDA before you get access to our systems.





BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of the list)



- You have handled PayPal or Klarna disputes before and can describe a real case

- Previous direct-response or dropshipping support

- Experience with high-volume US customers specifically

- Helpdesk tools - tell us which ones you have actually used: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, Commslayer, anything. It means you start faster.

- Any tool that makes you faster: text expanders, AI tools, order lookup tools. Tell us your setup.

- Any experience with Meta Ads Manager





THE TOOLS WE USE



Shopify Admin, Gmail, 17track, Google Sheets, PayPal and Klarna resolution centers,
 for internal communication, and an AI assistant for drafting. Every account you need is paid by us.





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Full written playbooks: response templates per brand, refund decision tree, dispute workflow, carrier patterns, escalation rules

- Training videos walking you through real past cases, start to finish

- Delegated inbox access - you never handle our passwords

- Every tool account and software licence you need, paid by us

- Direct feedback, and a standing invitation to tell us when something we built is bad





WORKING HOURS AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- 100% remote, from anywhere in the Philippines

- Right now: about 2 hours per day, sometimes up to 3 when volume is high. Roughly 10 to 15 hours per week.

- The hours depend on how much comes in. Quiet days you are done in an hour. After a big ad push it takes longer. You are paid per hour, so this works both ways - we are not going to pretend it is a fixed 40-hour job today.

- You choose when you work. The only rule: every customer
 answered within 24 hours, and your block lands in your morning so the overnight US inbox is cleared before it gets old.

- Day-to-day communication is asynchronous on
. No 
, no "quick calls", no being on call.

- One fixed 30-minute call per week, camera on. We agree on the day and time together once you start, and then it stays there. We go through the numbers, the problems that keep coming back, what you need from us, and what we think you should do differently. You get direct feedback and we expect you to use it. We also expect you to tell us when you think we are wrong - that call goes both ways. This is a team, not a hierarchy.

- We use time tracking. We say this openly because we would rather lose an applicant now than have a surprise later.

- Where this is going: we are scaling, and we are moving our ad launches onto software. Once you are solid on support, this role can grow into launching ad campaigns from creatives and briefs we prepare - execution inside a tool, not strategy, not creative decisions. More hours, more responsibility, more pay. If that sounds like something you want, say so in your application.





HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



Five numbers, nothing else:



1. First response time - under 24 hours, always

2. Inbox at zero at the end of every block

3. Disputes logged with their deadline, none missed, none lost by default

4. Escalation quality - is your recommendation usable as it is

5. Independence over time - fewer questions to us every month



We do not measure how many words you wrote.





COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



You are paid per hour, for the hours you actually work. We start low and we move you up fast. We are honest about that instead of promising you a number we do not know you are worth yet.



STEP 1 - PAID TRIAL: $2.50 per hour. Real tickets, real customers, from day one. You are paid for every hour of it whether or not we hire you. Short, and we d
 quickly.



STEP 2 - APPROVED: $3.00 per hour. The position is yours.



STEP 3 - PROVEN AND LONG-TERM: $3.50 per hour.



STEP 4 - FULLY OPERATING, running the whole inbox on your own: $4.00 per hour.



At roughly 10 to 15 hours per week that is about $110 to $260 per month today - and both the hours and the rate grow as we scale. We move people up this ladder fast when they earn it. We have never lost a great person over money and we do not plan to start.



Also included:



- Paid monthly, on time, every month, no exceptions, via Wise or PayPal

- A 13th month bonus after one full year

- Bonuses when the business does well - when we grow, you grow

- All tools and software licences paid by us, including your AI subscription if you do not have one

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- Freelance contract and NDA

- Long-term position - we want someone who grows with the brands



The steps above are not promises we forget about. They are tied to the five numbers under HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED, and we review on schedule.



One honest note: at today's hours this is a part-time income. If you currently work with another client, that is completely fine with us, as long as our
s are always answered within 24 hours. As we scale, this role is meant to become your main one.



Why we start at $2.50: we have hired for this role before and it did not work out, and it cost us months. The trial is where both of us find out. If you are good you are past it quickly - we have no interest in underpaying someone we want to keep.





ENGLISH



Our customers are American. A reply that reads translated costs us the sale, and a support agent we cannot have a normal conversation with costs us far more than that.



So there are two steps, and we are open about both. First, the short recording you send with your application - that is how we hear you before anyone spends time on a call. Then a video call in English, camera on, before we hire anyone. You need to be able to hold a normal working conversation: understand what we are asking, ask a question back, tell us when something is unclear.



Written English alone is not enough. We have been burned by exactly this before and we are not doing it again.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with TAMARIND - Your Full Name.



Keep it short. We are not asking you to do unpaid work to apply - nothing below takes more than ten minutes, and nothing below is work you have to invent for us. Be specific: vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. WHERE YOU DID SUPPORT BEFORE. Which companies or stores, for how long, and in which tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Gmail, whatever it was). Numbers, not adjectives.



2. HOW MANY
S PER DAY you handled there, and what your average first response time was.



3. YOUR SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE. What did you actually do in the admin? "Refunds, address edits, fulfillments, daily" tells us more than "I know Shopify".



4. YOUR AI SETUP. Which subscription do you have (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, other) and what do you use it for day to day?



5. YOUR TIME ZONE and the daily block you would work in.



6. ONE PIECE OF PROOF from your past support work. Your pick, and any of these is fine: a screenshot of your ticket stats, an SOP you followed or wrote, a few of the templates you worked with, or a reference we may contact. Black out or remove anything confidential - customer names, order data, anything your agreement with a past employer covers. We do not want you to break that agreement to apply here, and a redacted screenshot tells us everything we need. If you genuinely cannot share anything, write us a short SOP instead: "A customer writes that the package never arrived. Step by step, what do you do?" A few lines is enough.



7. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message, an unlisted YouTube link, whatever is easiest. Introduce yourself, tell us what you did in your last support role, and say why this one interests you. No production, no script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine. We are not judging your setup or your confidence on camera. We want to hear how you speak English, because that d
 whether this works.



That is it. No cover letter, no essay, no test task.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We read your answers and listen to your recording

2. Short video call in English, camera on

3. After the call: a small PAID trial on real cases from our inbox

4. Hire, starting rate, then the first review



The trial comes after we have spoken, not before. You get paid for it whether or not we hire you. We keep the number of trials small on purpose, so if you get there you are already a serious candidate.



Applications that do not start correctly, or that skip any of the 7 points, will not be reviewed. We are strict about this on purpose: following instructions exactly is the single most important part of this job.



We reply to every application that follows the instructions, and we reply fast.



If this sounds like you, apply today. We are hiring one person and we are hiring quickly.



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph - start your message with: TAMARIND - Your Full Name

title: Video Editor — Meta Ads Specialist (Ecommerce / Digital Products)
description:

If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.

We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.

We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.

What you'll own:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source them autonomously. High-quality clips only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d

Hook & Retention Instinct: You understand why the first seconds matter and can flag when a script or clip choice will kill retention — we want your opinion, not just your execution.

AI Tool Fluency: Comfortable using AI avatar/UGC tools (Arcads, MakeUGC, Higgsfield, etc.) and staying current on new releases relevant to ad production.

Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

Position Requirements:

Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

Immediate or near-immediate start.

2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing.

What We Offer:

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy.

We've prepared a short Google Form for you to complete, which also includes a Loom video where our CEO walks through everything you need to know before applying:

???? 

Please watch the Loom video first — if you feel you meet all the requirements, go ahead and fill out the form. Our CEO personally reviews every response.

title: Executive Assistant / Generalist VA — Creative Studio (Admin, Social, Client Ops)
description:
**Role**



Own the operational engine of the studio. One person, four surfaces: the founder's inbox and calendar, our published content, live client projects, and the top of the new-business funnel. You are the reason nothing gets dropped, nobody has to chase, and the founder spends their day on work only they can do. Scope is deliberately broad now and narrows later — as volume grows, content and social splits off into its own hire and you choose which half you want to lead.



**What you'll do**



Inbox and calendar

- Triage the founder's inbox daily: d
 what needs them, draft the routine replies, clear the rest

- Own the calendar across GST, EST, and PST — schedule, reschedule, defend focus blocks, never double-book

- Issue invoices, chase overdue payments, keep the expense log current

- Run Drive like a filing system, not a dumping ground: naming conventions, versioning, nothing unfindable

- Handle travel, vendor accounts, and subscription admin



Content and social

- Schedule and publish across Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube on a calendar you maintain

- Write captions in studio voice, adapt copy per platform, size and format every asset correctly

- Light Canva work and basic video trims, cuts, and subtitles

- Monitor comments and DMs, answer the routine ones, escalate what matters

- Flag calendar gaps two weeks out, before they become a scramble

- Pull monthly performance into a report that says what changed and why, not just the numbers



Client and project operations

- Be the fast, reliable reply on client threads — acknowledge same day, chase answers, keep nothing waiting

- Keep every project current in the tracker: statuses, owners, dates, blockers surfaced early

- Prepare briefs, agendas, and call recaps with clear owners and deadlines attached

- Manage deliverable handoffs — correct files, working links, on time, first try

- Run the follow-up loop after every call so nothing dies in someone's inbox



Research and new business

- Build and clean prospect lists against our target profile

- Research brands, competitors, and category trends into short usable summaries, not link dumps

- Run first-touch outreach sequences and track what gets answered

- Keep the CRM accurate: no duplicates, no stale records, no guessing



Cross-functional

- Write the SOP for every recurring task you take over, so the role is transferable by design

- Give a short daily status and one weekly call — otherwise fully async



**You should have**

- 2 to 5 years as a VA, EA, or agency coordinator, ideally inside a creative, media, or marketing business

- Writing strong enough to go out under someone else's name, US English

- A system for tracking commitments that lives outside your head

- Fluency in Google Workspace, a project tool (Notion, ClickUp, or Asana), and Canva

- Consistent overlap with Dubai hours and the discretion to sit near contracts, budgets, and unreleased work

- Bonus: CapCut or Premiere, social scheduling tools, CRM or outreach platforms, invoicing software



**How we measure it**

- Response time on client and inbound threads

- Deadlines held per project, and how early slippage gets flagged

- How few things the founder has to ask about twice

- Content published on schedule, at platform standard

- Qualified prospects added and sequenced per month



**Not a fit if**

- You need every task specified before you'll start it

- You go quiet when you're stuck

- You're serving several other clients during our working hours

We’re looking for a Marketing & Operations Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will split your time between driving our Amazon channel expansion and keeping the supply chain humming through weekly inventory checks and fulfilment routines.

_________________________________________________



Role Overview



First 3–6 Months Focus

Marketing Operations & Assistant Support

Operations & Supply Chain Support

- Conduct inventory planning and inventory fulfilment forecasting to keep stock aligned with demand.



- Support routine warehouse operations, including order splits, clearing warehouse stock, and routine fulfillment tasks.

_________________________________________________



You’re a Fit If You Have:



- Experience in building listings, uploading assets, setting up A+ Content, and managing FBA routines.



- Comfortable providing ad support by tracking keywords, impressions, and basic campaign performance metrics.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.

- Friendly and professional when managing incoming creator collaborations and basic website updates.



- Detail-oriented mindset that spots typos in listings or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between creative marketing tasks and practical operations support.

_________________________________________________



Why Join JazzUpCo?



- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants while sharpening your strategic project management skills and growing into a senior operations leader.



-Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________



Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:



1) Apply: Via the application form -
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview: Get to know each other

3) Trial Task: Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team: Onboarding + probation --> full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you!

title: VA - Guest Communication & Operations @ Restay Homes
description:
Hi!



My name is Nikita, I'm the founder of Restay Vacation Homes Rental - a short-term rental management company based in Dubai.



We manage 35+ furnished apartments in Dubai under sublease and property management, from studios to 3-bedrooms. We've held Airbnb Superhost status for the past year with a 4.8-4.9 rating across the whole portfolio, and we're adding units every month.



We're looking for one more VA to join our operations team.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
This is a long-term position with opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on quality, reliability, turnaround time, and channel growth.



Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates who fit our current budget.



Expected Workload

We are looking for an editor who can consistently edit approximately 4–8 long-form videos per month.

The exact workload may vary depending on channel needs.



About Us

We operate multiple faceless YouTube channels focused on:



- History

- Forgotten Wealth

- Dark Economics

- Geopolitics

- Forbidden Commodities

- Business History

- Documentary Storytelling



We are looking for a skilled editor who understands viewer retention and can transform a script and voice-over into an engaging documentary-style video.



Important

This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for editors who can create engaging documentary-style videos by combining storytelling, research, footage sourcing, graphics, music, and pacing.



What We Provide

Your Responsibilities

Requirements

- Strong experience editing YouTube videos

- Excellent storytelling and pacing skills

- Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

- Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

- Ability to independently source visuals and assets

- Reliable communication and attention to detail

- Fern

- Search Party

- Modern MBA

Long-Term Opportunity

- Additional editing projects

title: Podcast video editor
description:
Role Overview

You will own end-to-end video post-production for a weekly interview podcast. You will take raw multi-track

recordings and deliver a polished long-form episode, a podcast-ready audio file, and a set of vertical short-form

clips.

This is a role for an editor who works fluently with AI-assisted tools but brings real editorial judgment about pacing,

cuts, and what makes a moment land. The client is early in the show's life and actively developing their visual style,

so the first several episodes involve close collaboration and iteration. Your taste will shape the direction of the

show.



Responsibilities

Long-Form Editing

• Edit raw multi-track recordings into a polished episode, typically 30 minutes in length

• Build a clean side-by-side or multi-angle layout from separate host and guest video and audio tracks

• Remove filler, dead air, false starts, and tangents while preserving natural conversational flow

• Apply color correction and visual smoothing for a consistent look across episodes



Audio Production

• Perform audio cleanup, levelling, and noise reduction across separate speaker tracks

• Handle variable guest audio quality, since guests record remotely on their own equipment

• Deliver a podcast-ready audio file suitable for distribution



Short-Form Editing

• Cut 3 to 5 vertical clips per episode for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok

• Select moments with genuine standalone hook value rather than arbitrary segments

• Add clean, accurate captions and simple text treatments consistent with brand style



Collaboration and Workflow

• Work from a shared Riverside and Google Drive folder structure with clear stage gates

• Receive batched revision notes through 
 and turn them around cleanly in a single pass

• Stay reachable on the client's team channel for quick questions

• Help build and maintain a style and preferences document as feedback patterns emerge across the first month



Tools

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for primary editing

• AI-assisted clipping and transcription tools, used with editorial oversight

• Riverside for source recordings and transcripts

• 
 for review and feedback

• Google Drive and Google Workspace



Required Skills

• Two or more years editing long-form interview or talking-head video content

• Demonstrated short-form vertical editing with a clear sense of what holds attention

• Strong audio editing skills, particularly recovering usable audio from imperfect remote recordings

• Fluency with AI-assisted editing tools, paired with the judgment to recognize and override weak automated

output

• Reliable, organized file management and consistent turnaround against a batch workflow

• Strong written and spoken English for direct collaboration with the client team

• Comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback during an iterative early phase



Nice to Have

• Motion graphics and animated caption or transition work

• Thumbnail and still graphic design

• YouTube publishing, metadata, and SEO familiarity

• Multi-camera in-person production experience

• Background in e-commerce, creator economy, or B2B software content
