title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Operations Manager
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER



Remote — Philippines | Full-time | Monday–Friday | 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Applications sent through this platform's messaging system will not be reviewed.



Apply only here:





After submitting Tally, applicants who pass the initial requirements will be directed to a short recorded video pre-interview. Your application is not complete until both steps are submitted.



THE OPPORTUNITY



MajestIQ is hiring a high-ownership Operations Manager to become a long-term cornerstone of the company and grow toward a future Director of Operations role.



MajestIQ supports established Amazon sellers by preparing and submitting evidence concerning policy-violating and inauthentic review content. Amazon makes every final decision.



We are looking for a strong operator who can learn the business from the inside out, bring order to moving parts, build clear systems, help train future team members, and lead operations as the company expands.



The role begins hands-on. You will work closely with the founder, attend key meetings, learn how each part of the business operates, and steadily take on more ownership. The right person will help build and lead the team that grows beneath them.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Learn and organize the business



- Attend key meetings and learn how the business operates across teams, clients, systems, and daily workflows.

- Learn existing processes thoroughly before recommending or making improvements.

- Keep projects, information, follow-ups, and internal documentation organized.

- Turn verbal processes and working knowledge into clear, usable SOPs and checklists.

- Identify recurring workflow problems and opportunities to handle operations more consistently.



Improve operations and SOPs



- Help build simple, practical operating systems that people can actually use.

- Improve SOPs over time as the business learns what works.

- Maintain recurring workflows with clear ownership, high quality standards, and organized documentation.

- Support better processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.



Help build the future team



- Help onboard new team members as MajestIQ grows.

- Support training, documentation, and role clarity for future hires.

- Become a dependable resource for people who eventually work under you.

- Grow into managing team members, work quality, and operational follow-through as the company expands.



Support approved review operations



- After training, spend roughly two hours per day preparing and submitting approved review-related evidence through established SOPs.

- Follow approved processes carefully and escalate anything uncertain or outside the established rules.

- Do not invent arguments, make unsupported claims, or handle high-risk exceptions independently.



Work comfortably in a modern technology environment



- Use modern software, AI-enabled tools, automation, documentation systems, and technical platforms as part of normal operations.

- Use Slack confidently for channels, threads, search, huddles, reminders, workflow coordination, and clear written follow-through.

- You do not need to be a programmer or AI expert, but you must be comfortable learning and using new tools.

- This role is not a fit for someone who avoids new software or resists technology-driven ways of working.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should take pride in being reliable, organized, thoughtful, and capable.



- Exceptional spoken English and polished professional writing.

- Strong judgment and the ability to communicate clearly in meetings.

- Excellent organization and a habit of following through.

- The ability to learn unfamiliar workflows without constant hand-holding.

- Evidence that you have improved a process, created documentation, organized complex work, or helped a team operate better.

- Leadership potential, even if you have not formally managed a large team before.

- Interest in staying with one company, learning the business deeply, and growing into a larger role.

- Comfort using modern software, AI-enabled tools, automation, and technical platforms.

- Strong Slack fluency: you must be well versed in channels, threads, search, huddles, reminders, and turning conversations into clear follow-up.

- A stable work environment and the ability to reliably work the required overnight Philippines schedule.



Amazon Seller Central, e-commerce operations, or experience supporting an Amazon-focused business is strongly preferred. It is not mandatory for an exceptional operations candidate with the communication skills, judgment, and long-term potential this role requires.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, Monday through Friday.

- 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

- This is an evening-to-overnight schedule in the Philippines.

- The U.S. Eastern Time schedule is controlling. Because the United States observes daylight saving time, the corresponding Philippine clock time shifts by one hour during the year.

- You must be present for key meetings and normal operating hours.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



- Starting rate: $11/hour.

- After 90 days: $12/hour.

- After 6 months: $13/hour.

- Paid Philippine holidays.

- Eligibility for performance bonuses tied to real operational results.



Strong performance can lead to increasing responsibility and a Director of Operations path as the team grows.



HIRING PROCESS



We expect significant interest in this role. To respect everyone's time and keep the process fair, the hiring process is structured:



1. Short Tally application with role-fit and availability questions.

2. Required recorded video pre-interview, approximately 10–12 minutes total.

3. Scorecard-based review and shortlist.

4. Short practical exercise for finalists.

5. Final conversation with the founder for only the strongest candidates.

6. References and a paid two-week trial: four hours per day, Monday through Friday.

7. Full-time offer for the right long-term fit.



The recorded pre-interview includes a simple practice check and a few time-limited questions. It is not designed to be an unreasonable test. It helps us understand communication, judgment, commitment, and role fit before scheduling live conversations.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not apply or send a generic cover letter through this platform.



Complete the MajestIQ application using the Tally link at the top of this post.



Applicants who pass the initial Tally requirements will see a button to begin the recorded HireVire pre-interview. Click that button and complete the interview; both steps are required for a complete application.



If you are highly organized, communicate exceptionally well, work comfortably with modern technology, and want to build a long-term career inside a growing company, we would like to hear from you.

title: SEO content and topical authority assistant
description:
We are looking for a reliable SEO content specialist to support a growing portfolio of UK businesses across several different industries.



This is not a role for someone who simply generates articles using ChatGPT and sends them over.



We already use AI extensively.



What we need is someone who can think.



You should understand why a page exists, what somebody is searching for, how that page fits into the wider website, what supporting content should surround it, and how to make the finished content sound like the actual business rather than generic AI-generated copy.



This will initially be a part-time position with the potential to grow significantly for the right person.



## What you will be doing



Your work will include:



* Researching topics and search intent before writing

* Reviewing Google search results and competitor content

* Creating SEO content briefs

* Identifying content clusters and supporting article opportunities

* Writing service pages, location pages, landing pages and articles

* Creating internal linking recommendations

* Identifying relevant entities, subtopics and FAQs

* Following an existing keyword strategy where provided

* Helping expand broad keywords into useful topical clusters

* Matching the tone of voice of completely different client brands

* Updating and improving existing content

* Structuring articles properly using headings and logical information hierarchy

* Using AI to accelerate your work without allowing AI to replace your judgement

* Fact checking anything generated with AI before submitting it



You will not initially be responsible for uploading content into WordPress.



Your responsibility is creating high-quality content and recommendations that are ready for our team to review and publish.



## What good work looks like



If we give you a plumbing company, SaaS company and professional services business, the content should not sound like it came from the same writer or prompt.



Before writing an article, you should naturally be asking questions such as:



What is the actual search intent?



What pages already exist on the website?



What should this page link to?



What pages should link back to this page?



Is this a standalone topic or part of a larger cluster?



What information is competitors consistently covering?



What are competitors missing?



Does this article genuinely deserve to rank?



Could somebody tell that AI helped produce this?



If your process is simply keyword + prompt + 1,500-word article, this role will not be a good fit.



## Skills we are looking for



You should have experience with several of the following:



* SEO content writing

* Search intent analysis

* Keyword research

* Topic clustering

* Topical authority

* Content briefs

* Content optimisation

* Internal linking

* Competitor research

* SERP analysis

* Google Search Console

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar SEO tools

* WordPress

* ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools



You do not need to know everything.



Strong thinking, attention to detail and reliability matter more to us than having every SEO certification available.



## Using AI



We actively encourage the use of AI.



However, there is a major difference between using AI as a tool and submitting AI-generated content without thinking.



AI can help you research, organise, expand, draft and edit.



You are still responsible for:



* Accuracy

* Originality

* Search intent

* Structure

* Brand voice

* Relevance

* Quality



We will reject generic AI content.



## Working arrangement



This is initially a part-time remote position.



Starting budget:



$200 to $300 USD per month depending on experience, availability and output.



We care more about consistent high-quality output than tracking every minute you work.



If you become someone we can trust across client accounts, there is substantial scope for the role, responsibilities and compensation to increase.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming part of the way we operate rather than somebody looking to churn through another freelance writing gig.



## How to apply



Please do not send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



**Purple Penguin**



Applications without those words will be ignored.



Then answer the following five questions.



### 1. Show us your work



Send links to two pieces of SEO content you personally created.



For each one, briefly explain:



* What keyword or topic you targeted

* What the search intent was

* What you personally did

* Why you structured the content the way you did



### 2. Show us how you think about clusters



Imagine you are working with a UK plumber who wants to rank for:



**boiler installation**



Give us:



* The primary page you would create

* Five supporting content ideas

* Two related commercial pages

* How you would internally link these pages together



Keep this concise.



### 3. Tell us how you use AI



Explain exactly how you currently use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool when creating SEO content.



We are not looking for somebody who claims they never use AI.



We want to understand your process.



### 4. Spot the problem



Tell us why the following approach is weak:



"Find a keyword with good volume, ask ChatGPT to write a 2,000-word SEO article about it, add the keyword to the title and headings, then publish it."



Your answer should be no more than 150 words.



### 5. Tell us about you



Include:



* Your current availability

* Your expected monthly salary

* Your timezone

* How many clients or employers you currently work with

* The SEO tools you have previously used



Finally, at the bottom of your application, tell us your favourite food.



This is simply to confirm you have read the entire job description.



## Important



Please do not apply if:



* You submit completely AI-generated applications

* You cannot demonstrate previous writing

* You frequently miss deadlines

* You need detailed instructions for every small task

* You consider SEO writing to mean putting keywords into an article repeatedly

* You are applying for dozens of unrelated VA jobs at the same time



We are happy to teach our processes.



We cannot teach care, curiosity or reliability.



If you are someone who enjoys understanding why content performs rather than simply producing more words, we would like to hear from you.

title: Video Editor (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Video Editor (Full-Time, Remote)



DMPH Marketing

$800 to $1,200 USD per month, based on experience



Who we are

DMPH Marketing is an AI-first marketing agency built around content. We make video and creative that helps our clients get noticed in industries where most brands look and sound the same.

Two things define how we work. First, detail: we care about the frame, the cut, and the mix, not just whether the file exports. Second, fit: every project gets built around that client's vision instead of being run through the same template.



AI is how we hold both of those at volume. We build it into our production workflows so our editors spend less time on the mechanical parts of the job and more time on the parts that actually require taste. The tools handle the grunt work. The judgment is still human, and that's the part we hire for.



We're growing, and we're adding a Video Editor who works the same way. We need someone already familiar with AI integration workflows, not someone we have to teach from zero.



The role

Full-time, 40 hours per week, remote. Hours are flexible, but client work moves fast and we need you reachable when something urgent comes up.

title: Cold Caller / Objection Handler
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER

Remote | Full-time, around 160 hours per month | You choose how you get paid



================================================================

READ THIS FIRST: HOW TO APPLY

================================================================



To be considered, you must submit a recorded video. Face on camera,

two minutes maximum.



In the video, do two things:



1. Introduce yourself.



2. Answer this: you have just called a business owner, and ten

   seconds in he says "I'm not interested." Say out loud, word for

   word, exactly what you would say next.



Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We are not

looking at resumes. We are looking at how you sound and how you

think on your feet.





================================================================

COMPENSATION: YOU PICK

================================================================



OPTION A: COMMISSION ONLY

$75 per qualified, attended sales call. No base.



OPTION B: BASE PLUS COMMISSION

$700 per month guaranteed, plus $30 per qualified, attended sales

call.



Same job either way. You choose the structure when you accept the

offer. Option A pays significantly more if you can produce.

Option B guarantees money while you ramp.



WHAT YOU CAN EARN



  3 qualified calls/week:   $975/mo (A)  or  $1,090/mo (B)

  5 qualified calls/week: $1,650/mo (A)  or  $1,360/mo (B)

  6 qualified calls/week: $1,950/mo (A)  or  $1,480/mo (B)

 10 qualified calls/week: $3,225/mo (A)  or  $1,990/mo (B)

 15 qualified calls/week: $4,875/mo (A)  or  $2,650/mo (B)



From about 4 qualified calls a week up, Option A wins and keeps

winning. Our current caller books about 20 appointments a week,

and roughly 6 of those attend. That is the number to beat.



START ON OPTION B, SWITCH TO OPTION A AFTER 60 DAYS.

Take the safety net while you ramp, then go get the ceiling.

Your call, no penalty.





================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================



We provide the leads. You make the calls. You book qualified

meetings. You get paid when they show up.



Lead lists, dialer, scripts, and the offer are already built. Your

job is the phone, and specifically, your job is what happens after

someone says no.





================================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

================================================================



- Make outbound calls to our provided prospect lists

- Get past the first "no" instead of taking it at face value

- Handle real objections
 "not interested," "send me an

 
," "we already have someone"

- Qualify prospects against a clear, written standard

- Book appointments and confirm them so they actually attend

- Keep clean notes and hold high, consistent call volume

- Take coaching and keep improving





================================================================

WHAT "QUALIFIED" MEANS

================================================================



You get the written definition before your first call. No moving

goalposts, no judgment calls after the fact. If a prospect meets

the criteria and attends, you get paid.





================================================================

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

================================================================



A shark. Someone who can think on their feet while a stranger is

actively trying to get off the phone.



- A STRONG OBJECTION HANDLER ABOVE ALL ELSE. This is the job.

- Hears "not interested" as the start of the conversation, not

  the end

- Confident with strangers and comfortable being told no all day

- Quick on their feet, not dependent on a script

- Competitive and motivated by performance pay

- Coachable, reliable, consistent



Cold calling or sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. We

care about what you can do on the phone today.





================================================================

WHAT WE PROVIDE

================================================================



- Prospect lists and calling infrastructure

- Sales scripts and objection-handling frameworks

- Training and ongoing coaching

- Warm leads in rotation

- A clear, written qualification standard





================================================================

THE REST OF THE PROCESS

================================================================



After the video: a short interview, then a live calling and

roleplay evaluation where we play a difficult prospect and throw

real objections at you. That is the whole test.



If you are confident on the phone and want your income tied to

what you produce, we want to hear from you.





Evan

Managing Director, Ascension AI

title: Civil/General Construction Estimator
description:
CIVIL / GENERAL CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR – U.S. PROJECTS



Remote | Philippines



Granite State Business Holdings (GSBH) is looking for experienced CIVIL / GENERAL CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATORS to support our growing Estimating & Preconstruction team.



We support multiple U.S.-based construction companies and are looking for estimators who can confidently review plans and specifications, perform detailed quantity takeoffs, develop cost estimates, and help prepare accurate and competitive bids.



Our priority is finding candidates with strong CIVIL ESTIMATING experience. However, candidates who also have broader GENERAL CONSTRUCTION estimating experience are highly preferred, as our projects may involve different trades and scopes.



*** EXPERIENCE ESTIMATING U.S.-BASED CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS IS HIGHLY PREFERRED. ***



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Review construction drawings, specifications, addenda, and bid documents

Perform detailed and accurate quantity takeoffs

Prepare construction cost estimates and bid worksheets

Estimate civil scopes such as sitework, earthwork, excavation, utilities, drainage, paving, concrete, and related work

Estimate additional general construction trades based on your experience

Determine material, labor, equipment, and subcontractor requirements

Review plans for missing scope, discrepancies, constructability concerns, and potential estimating risks

Review addenda and incorporate revisions into estimates

Identify missing or unclear information that may require an RFI

Gather and compare vendor, supplier, and subcontractor pricing

Review quotations for pricing and scope completeness

Look for opportunities to obtain better and more competitive pricing

Clearly document estimate assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, and clarifications

Maintain organized takeoffs, quotes, estimates, and project files

Support additional estimating and preconstruction tasks as needed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who can do MORE THAN JUST QUANTITY TAKEOFFS.



A strong candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of an estimating assignment and working independently with minimal supervision.



You should be able to:



Review plans and specifications and understand the overall project scope

Determine what needs to be included in the estimate

Perform accurate and organized quantity takeoffs

Understand how the work will be constructed in the field

Determine appropriate materials, labor, equipment, and subcontractor needs

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and unclear requirements

Ask the right questions when additional information is needed

Research pricing when necessary

Produce a clear and organized estimate that is ready for review

Manage deadlines and communicate progress or concerns proactively



You DO NOT need to be an expert in every construction trade.



Our priority is strong CIVIL ESTIMATING experience, but candidates with broader GENERAL CONSTRUCTION estimating experience will have an advantage.



We are especially interested in estimators who are ACCURATE, DEPENDABLE, RESOURCEFUL, and comfortable working independently while communicating well with the rest of the team.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



At least 2 years of construction estimating experience

Strong civil construction estimating experience

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from construction drawings and specifications

Ability to read and understand civil, grading, utility, drainage, site development, and construction plans

Good understanding of construction materials, labor, equipment, and methods

Ability to independently develop estimates from plans and specifications

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel

Experience with construction takeoff or estimating software

Good written and spoken English

Ability to manage deadlines and multiple estimating assignments

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Full-Time (40+ hours per week, depending on business needs)

Working Hours: U.S. Central Time (CST)



Job Description



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities



Open Items Follow Up

Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.



Client Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.



Document Review and Organization

Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

Upload, categorize, and organize files in the appropriate client folder or system.

Update open-item lists immediately when documents or responses are received.

Confirm that resolved items are properly closed before work is returned to the tax or accounting team.



Internal Coordination

Communicate with tax preparers, reviewers, bookkeepers, and other team members regarding unresolved items.

Ask internal team members for clarification when a request is unclear or appears duplicative.

Provide clear status updates on clients with outstanding items.

Notify the appropriate team member when all requested information has been received.

Escalate technical tax or accounting questions rather than attempting to answer them independently.



Deadline Management

Monitor due dates associated with open requests.

Prioritize follow-ups based on filing deadlines, internal deadlines, and engagement urgency.

Follow up before outstanding items become urgent.

Maintain accurate tracking so the team has visibility into delayed or unresponsive clients.

Ensure no engagement is delayed without documented follow-up and escalation.



Role Expectations

Open-item requests are accurate and do not duplicate information already provided.

Clients receive timely, clear, and professional follow-up.

Outstanding items are followed through to completion rather than simply requested once.

Client responses and documents are accurately tracked and organized.

Unresponsive clients are escalated early.

The tax and accounting teams can quickly see what is missing and what has been received.

No engagement falls behind because an open item was forgotten or not followed up on.



Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Tax, Bookkeeping, Finance, or a related field

Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

Strong understanding of the U.S. tax return preparation process for both individual and business tax engagements

Familiarity with the following U.S. tax forms is strongly preferred:



Individual Tax Forms

Form 1040 – U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

Schedule A – Itemized Deductions

Schedule B – Interest and Ordinary Dividends

Schedule C – Profit or Loss from Business

Schedule D – Capital Gains and Losses

Schedule E – Supplemental Income and Loss

Form 4562 – Depreciation and Amortization

Form 4797 – Sales of Business Property

Form 8582 – Passive Activity Loss Limitations

Form 8829 – Business Use of Home

Form 8949 – Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

Form 8995 / Form 8995-A – Qualified Business Income (QBI) Deduction



Business Tax Forms

Form 1120 – U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

Form 1120-S – U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation

Form 1065 – U.S. Return of Partnership Income

Form 1041 – U.S. Income Tax Return for Estates and Trusts

Form 941 – Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return

Form 940 – Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return

Forms W-2 and W-3

Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and 1099-INT

Form 1096 – Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns



Ability to identify missing tax documents and proactively follow up on open items with clients and internal team members until resolved

Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and clearly with clients

Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills

High attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality

Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Comfortable using cloud-based tax software, document management systems, and project management tools

Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team

Available to work full-time during U.S. business hours (9:00 AM CST – 6:00 PM CST)



Our Core Values

1. Bring Fun Tax Energy

We're genuinely obsessed with tax — the rules, the strategy, the wins for clients — and that obsession is contagious. We show up with real energy, take pride in the work, and make the experience good for each other and for the client. A great attitude isn't soft; it makes the work better and the people around us better.



2. Speed Drives Results

We love to win, and winning means getting it done. Immediately. We learn fast, adapt fast, and move — because knowing the answer isn't the job, acting on it is. Momentum compounds: the faster we turn knowledge into action, the better the outcome for the client and the firm.



3. Own the Outcome

The result is yours, full stop. We don't love excuses, even if they are real — we love getting results. We don't hand off problems, we solve them. We follow through on what we said we'd do, and when something's in the way, we do what it takes to get it done. No "not my job."



All applications require a 1–2 minute video introduction, along with your resume attached. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

* QuickBooks Online

* Month-end close

* Balance sheet reconciliations beyond bank and credit card accounts

* Payroll entries and payroll liability reconciliations

* Loans, fixed assets, AR, AP and equity accounts

* Cleaning up inaccurate or poorly maintained books

* Reviewing financial statements for unusual or incorrect balances



Experience working with multiple U.S.-based accounting clients is required.** This is not a preference. If your experience is primarily with a single company or with non-U.S. accounting, this position is not a fit.

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant (Shopify / TikTok Shop)
description:
The company

A profitable, growing US-based specialty Tea Subscription ecommerce brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders) selling through Shopify, TikTok Shop, and a subscription program, with international warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU. The store operations side of the business is run by one teammate who is moving to a technical lead role, you'll be his right hand.



The role

You take the store operational work off the Technical Lead's plate so he can build. This is execution, monitoring, and data maintenance work, done reliably and precisely. You are not making purchasing decisions or writing code. You ARE the person who makes sure listings are right, inventory data is current, orders are tracked, and nothing falls through the cracks.

This role is also a growth path: the brand runs custom-built software and an AI agent for inventory intelligence. Start with the basics done flawlessly, and you'll be trained into the more complex systems.



What you'll do



Product listings and administration (Shopify + TikTok Shop)

-Create draft product listings from provided info: photos, videos, descriptions, SKUs, tags, collections, pricing

-Keep Shopify and TikTok Shop listings matched and in sync

-Audit listings for missing images, broken info, wrong tags; prep new listings for final review

-Handle backend product work: tagging, pricing updates, bundle linking (the brand has many SKUs and complex bundles)



Purchasing data maintenance

-Maintain the buying table used for purchasing coordination with the overseas team

-Log ordered products, tag in-transit inventory in the forecasting tool (Prediko), update incoming quantities

-Flag missing or inconsistent data. Buying decisions stay with the Technical Lead and sourcing team; your job is making sure the data they d
 from is right

-Inventory, orders, and fulfillment monitoring

-Routine checks on warehouse/fulfillment status and shipment tracking across Shopify, OMS, and spreadsheets

-Flag unresolved orders instead of letting them sit



Website support and QA

-Handle simple Shopify/website requests from the Customer Service team: text, images, FAQs, links, product settings

-Run checklist-based testing after site changes; test customer-facing scenarios, document issues with screenshots and repro steps, escalate anything technical



Task hygiene

-Keep Asana organized: statuses updated, stale tasks flagged, follow-ups chased



What you need

Hands-on Shopify admin experience (listings, products, collections, basic settings). TikTok Shop experience is a strong plus

Precise, reliable, detail-obsessed. This role is 80% "did it get done correctly, every time"

Comfortable in spreadsheets and matching data across systems

Smart enough to learn custom internal software. You don't need to code; you need to not be scared of new tools

Genuinely curious about AI tools: open, playful, and safe with them. You'll eventually work alongside an AI inventory agent

Strong written English; you'll coordinate with the Customer Service team and document issues clearly

Available during US Eastern business hours (any home timezone)



Nice to have

You drink tea, or want to. This brand sells specialty Chinese tea: loose leaf, pu-erh, oolong, matcha, teaware. Knowing the difference between a green tea and a red tea means you'll catch listing errors a generic VA never would, like a product tagged in the wrong category or a description that doesn't match the leaf. You don't need to be an expert; the team will happily deepen your education

Interest in Chinese culture or language

TikTok Shop seller-side experience

Experience supporting a founder-creator brand where product accuracy and authenticity are the standard

Prior QA or testing experience with documented repro steps
